pages.title: show critique 2009
blocks: Southern English Setter Society – 21st November 2009
DOGS

I was very pleased with the quality of dogs here today. The younger classes whilst not large, held some very nice, very promising dogs which can only bode well for the breed. BIS was Wansleydale Rowanberry of Valsett, RBIS Richecca Paper Doll with Upperwood and BPIS Redhara Crystal Cracker.

Minor Puppy 3 (1) . 1.Littlechild’ Ravensett Armani. Very smart o/b of good size, classic head with lovely head and dark eyes, short coupled, very good tailset and carriage, good hind movement, a little loose in front but just right for age. 2.Hill’s Mandyset Slippery Customer. 6 month o/b with lovely head, showing a lot of promise and moving nicely.

Puppy 2 1.Oliver’s Bramstorm Walk The Line. Dark b/b/t of correct size, nice head and expression good reach of neck, nice outline with really well angulated hindquarters, moved well to win this class. 2.Golby & Martin’s Sunhouse Here Comes The Sun to Shadymoore. Promising dark o/b with very nice head, strong bone, level topline, moved well behind , still a little erratic in front but this will change with age, not as forward as 1 but a lot to like about him.

Veteran 6 (2). 1.Hammond’s Bournehouse Paper Parade for Oaktrish. 9 years old with best outline in this class, b/b/t with nice head and soft expression, straight front, a little heavy over the shoulder but with deep body, good quarters, very happy on the move. 2.Holland’s Mandyset Dirty Dancing. 8 years b/b in lovely coat, straight front with good length of upper arm, nicely angulated, moved well but not the drive of 1. 3.Jolley’s Dyrham Dont Stop Me Now In Jolymore

Junior 6 (3). 1.Swannell’s Rickory Up Close `N` Personal. Promising & very nice b/b of good size and substance, elegant outline, lovely reach of neck, deep body and strong quarter, good tailset and in good condition and well coated, moved well. 2.Mitchell & Withey’s Sunsprake Raging Storm over Scratchwood. O/b I liked a great deal but who is very much at the teenage stage and now needs to deepen in body and grow his adult coat, another who is very promising and when he matures should do really well. 3.Hutchinson’s Walshaw Midnight Moonlight

Yearling 5 (1). 1.Sayer’s Mariglen Blue Flame for Christter b/b with lovely head, clean & elegant outline, long reach of neck into well laid shoulders, straight front, level topline with well angulated front and hind quarters, excellent tailset, free, easy mover. A very nice young dog. 2.Grimsdell’s Tattersett Doctor Woody JW, b/b and very close up to 1, larger framed dog with super depth of body, good bone & tight feet, very nice head, excellent angulation, in very hard condition, in profuse coat, moved well behind but was a little erratic today in front movement. 3.Wood’s Swannery Magical Moment
Maiden 1. 1.Salmon’s Burleycott Irish Cream. O/b with nice head & eyes, straight front, in nice condition, happy on the move.
Novice 3 (2). 1.Hutchinson’s Walshaw Midnight Moonlight. b/b of nice type, lovely head, straight front, tight feet, in hard condition, sound mover, just needs more body.

Tyro 3 1.Ball & Morgan’s Gemsett I Am Legent, elegant b/b with nice head, arched neck of correct length into good shoulders, correct outline, strong quarters, nice front and good bone, best mover in this class. 2.Full’s Daraquist Leading Partner, good size o/b with lovely expression, well off for bone and body and in good condition, wouldn’t settle on the move but has a lovely tail action. 3.Swannery Magical Moment

Graduate 7 (4). 1.Loakes’ Goldbirch Guys N Dolls JW, o/b of good size and substance, nice head and expression, straight front, level topline with strong, angulated hindquarters, lovely coat and condition and sound on the move 2.Darley’s Severnsett Mark of Zorro very flashy b/b, correct head and dark eye, well off for bone, deep body, beautifully presented in lovely coat, moved well when settled, close up to 1. 3.Full’s Daraquist Leading Partner

Post Graduate 9 (3). 1.Sykes’ Daraquist Down Under beautiful, compact dark o/b with most lovely head and appealing expression, strong neck into well laid shoulders, he has a level back, is well ribbed up and with good depth of body, an extrovert he moved really well using his hocks and holding his topline, in hard condition. Res cc. 2.Stephenson’s Wansleydale Huckleberry at Steeplow, dark b/b/t and another who I liked very much, slightly heavier than 1 but still a very balanced young dog , good head, correct topline and rib and scores highly in rear angulation with good tailset and carriage, moved well. 3.Fisher’s Beechanger Wagtail JW

Limit 7. 1.Wright’s Fishwick Dancing Lad, top class o/b of excellent type, size and balance. Loved his head and expression, straight front with tight elbows and good length of upper arm, good bone and spring of rib, level back, good bend of stifle, in lovely coat & condition, moved soundly here but unfortunately did not put in any effort in the challenge. Am sure will obtain his title if his enthusiasm returns. 2.Goutorbe’s Redhara Bobby Dazzler JW, dark b/b/t with lovely outline, dark eye with gentle expression, has good neck & shoulders, short coupled, strong topline with deep, well ribbed body, well angulated, tended to move a little wide behind today but in profile is very impressive. 3.Golby’s Shadymoore Cowboys N Kisses

Open 12 (2) A difficult class with some dogs who looked very good standing just not performing on the move 1.Watkins’ Wansleydale Rowanberry of Valsett, glamorous o/b presented in top order, a very balanced dog with correct head, arched, well muscled neck, deep chest with good bone and feet, very good spring of rib, level back and excellent hindquarters, liked him very much standing but felt that on the move he really came into his own covering the ground with strength and precision with a constant wagging tail, CC & BIS .2.Stubbington & Buckley’s Sh Ch Bondgate Single Malt, o/b dog with lovely head and expression, long neck, straight front with good bone, level back, well angulated front and rear, scored over 1 in shoulder, sound on the move but today unlucky to meet 1 in such form. 3.Mombaers’ Ch Ballykissangels Electrode

Special Beginners 5 (2). 1.Atyeo’s Harvencourt Nice Touch, b/b/t boy with nice head and expression, good neck & shoulder, straight front and good hindquarters, moved soundly. 2.Mellish’s Walshaw Christmas Spirit at Monbrec, o/b of good size & substance, good arch to neck, in nice coat and good condition, in his teenage stage at the moment.
Karen Barker
THE SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY
BREED CHAMPIONSHIP SHOW
SESS CHAMPIONSHIP SHOW 21st November 2009 :
Bitches
I would like to thank the committee for a lovely day and the ladies in the kitchen for a superb meal.

Minor Puppy Bitch 3 (1 abs). 1. Cozens’s Mandyset Blue Murder B/B : 6 ½ months very pretty headed and sweetest expression. Lovely dark eye and correct shape. Straight front into well laid shoulders, deep body, short coupled, tail never stopped wagging. Lovely coat and condition. Needs to settle on the move but first time out and full of herself. 2. Seawards Mandyset Aint Misbehavin'. Tri. Litter sister to 1, same remarks apply. Longer cast than one and not so sure of herself.

Puppy Bitch 3. 1. Goutorbe’s Redara Crystal Cracker : Tri. What a cracker, sweet head, dark eye. Straight front into well laid shoulders. Good body, deep chest. Have handler a hard time, moved soundly with slashing tail. Best Puppy Bitch and B.P.I.S in agreement with co-judge. 2. Oliver’s Line Dancer B/B. Dark blue, gorgeous head, dark eye. Straight front to good shoulder placement, not the body of 1 and longer cast. Gave her handler a hard time on the move. 3. Green’s Tattersett Honeysuckle

Veteran 7 (4abs). What a trio of lovely old ladies enjoying their day out. 1. Dunk’s Samelan Star Bright B/B 9 ½ yrs old. Beautiful headed bitch with the kindest eye and expression. Excellent front, neck and shoulder placement. Well ribbed and good body. Kept her topline on the move and one of the best movers of the day with a lashing tail. A credit to her owner. Best Veteran in Show, in agreement with my co-judge. 2. Davis Merleycopse Love of a Lady. B/B Sweet head, dark eye. Good body, longer cast than 1. Moved well. 3. Greenham’s Lewkins Wideload Winnie at Frizzanti.

Junior 7 (2 abs). 1. Watkins Valsett Starlite Rosie Moon O/B. Well chiselled head and lovely dark eye. Straight front to well laid shoulder, good bone. Deep body, well ribbed. Good bend of stifle. Moved with drive. Immaculately presented in good coat and condition. 2. Mitchell amd Withey’s Sunsprake Summer Breeze O/B. Another lovely bitch who could change places on another day. Sweet head, dark eye. Good neck and shoulders, well ribbed. Moved soundly. Just left her coat behind but this did not detract from her lovely shape. 3. Tucker’s Walshaw Moonlight and Roses

Yearling 6 (2abs). 1. Baker’s Mandyset Pop Tart. Tri. Very dark tri, beautiful headed bitch with correct eye shape and colour. Well off for bone. Excellent reach of neck into well laid shoulders. Well ribbed deep body. My only criticism feet could be tighter. Moved with drive and style. 2. Aryeo’s Pewterspeare Prying Eyes Pale Tri.Stronger in head than 1 but still feminine. Deep chest, well ribbed and bodied. Good bend of stifle. Lovely tail action on the move. 3. Neath’s Albadora Miss Quizadora
Maiden 2. 1. Goutorbe’s Redara Crystal Cracker . 2. Aryeo’s Pewterspeare Prying Eyes
Novice 4 (1 abs). 1. Goutorbe’s Redara Crystal Cracker 2. Aryeo’s Pewterspeare Prying Eyes .3. Neath’s Albadora Miss Quizadora
Tyro 2 (1 abs). 1. Tucker’s Walshaw Moonlight & Roses ; pretty B/B 3rd in a strong junior class. Sweet head, good eye colour and shape. Needs to body up but plenty to like about her. Moved well.

Graduate (1 ) 1. Carlin’s Wynacre Last Tango for Sodalitas O/B. Stood alone but a worthy winner. Well chisled head, sweet expression. Excellent body and well bent stifles. Moved soundly with lovely tail action.

Post Graduate 12 (3 abs)/. 1. Attwood’s Swannery Finlandia O/B. Sweetest of heads, soft melting expression. Correct upper arm and lay back of shoulders. Well ribbed and carrying the correct weight. Well bent stifles. Balanced picture standing and moved well. 2. Henry’s Beechanger Little Shrew Tri. Well chisled head. Good bone, eell ribbed. Played her handler up but eventually settled and moved soundly. 3. Baker’s Mandyset What a Diamond.

Limit 10 (1 abs). A lovely class of quality bitches.1. Goutorbe’s Richecca Paper Doll with Upperwood. O/B A bitch I have admired from the ringside and I was not disappointed on going over her. A head to die for, well chiselled, dark eye, soft kind expression. Long neck into well laid shoulders. Well ribbed and carrying correct weight. Well bent stifles. A picture standing. Could have done with a bigger ring to do the bitch justice. The one I would dearly loved to take home. C.C. R.B.I.S. 2. Kelly’s Richecca Watercol;ours B/B. Litter sister to 1. Dark blue with lovely head and dark eye. Well ribbed, short coupled. Beautifully presented, moved with drive. Shame to meet 1 on top form. Both bitches a credit to their breeder. 3. Grimsdell’s Tattersett Air of Elegance

Open 7 (3 abs) 1. Morgan and Bott’s Sh Ch Quensha Little Jeanie JW O/B.Lovely headed bitch, best of neck and shoulders. Deep brisket, short coupled, well made all through. Moved well. R.C.C. 2. Dennis & Fields Sh.Ch. Mariglen Franscesca Fenston O/B.Another lovely headed bitch. Well ribbed and deep chest. Longer cast than one. Immaculately put down as usual from this kennel. Very sound on the move 3. Baker’s Mandyset Only A Caution

Special Beginners 3. 1. Carlin’s Wynacre Last Tango for Sodalitasa.2. Davis Culverwell Calypso of Merleycopse O/B. Good neck and shoulders, well bodied. Played up on the move.3. Gardners Cheyneygate Blesma Soul
Christine Normansell (Judge)

blocks: SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY November 2010 Dogs

Lovely to meet so many old SESS friends again. Better use of the venue having dogs use the well matted ring first followed at once by the Bitches - Judge by Val Watkins. The Referee judges B.O.B & B.I.S given to Margaret Botts o/b Sh CH Quensha Little Jeanie J.W.. RBIS Sayers & Dennis Sh CH Mariglen Blue Flame for Christter. BP . Goutorbe Upperwood Snowbell for Redhara.

1. MINOR PUPPY DOG .(4). 1 Henrys BEECHANGER DUKE OF ARGUS. BPD. Just right for age raw but all the essentials lovely head, reasonably lean, well-defined stop, square muzzle, good eye and expression, balanced well boned. moved well. Murray & Berry HARVANCOURTS MIRACLE. Balanced typical baby, good head, not quite positive in rear drive, but this will come.3 Mellish HARVANCOURT MIRACLE TOUCH FOR MONBREC. Keep up with the ringcraft.
Class 2. PUPPY DOG (1) 1. Jones. KERRIMERE CATCH A DREAM FOR REDBORNSTOKE. Balanced, correct back, short and level, well set on tail, good spring of rib, deep in brisket, good stifles, steady mover.
Class 3. VETERAN DOG (2). 1st Holland MANDYSET DIRTY DANCING. Lovely headed, balanced 8yr old in lovely coat & condition. 2 Kirch SOUL MATE OF SORBUS. IN lovely coat & condition moved strongly.

Class 4 JUNIOR DOG (2).1. Thompson RAVENSETT RALPH LAUREN. A balanced, good headed youngster with good ribs and quarters, need to develop his rather narrow front & strengthen pasterns. Free mover and correct drive from hindquarters.

Class 5. YEARLING DOG (5).1. Watkins MARIGLEN SNOWDRIFT AT HAYWORTH. Pleasing quality youngster, clean in outline good ribs, quarters, feet & bone. Moved soundly but the ring restrictions in size meant you did not see him stride out. In lovely coat & condition.2 Bridgewater & Davies & Jeffery . BRUCELM DIAMOND HARRY ROCKS BRIDGELLA. Attractive dog, not quite balanced as 1st. good front, bone, deep brisket, correct with of chest, well ribbed up. Strong quarters, move well. 3 De Bok FANTAILS KEEP THEM TALKING.
Class 6 NOVICE DOG((1).1. Mellish HARVANCOURT MIRACLE TOUCH FOR MONBREC
Class 7 GRADUATE DOG (5).1 Bridgewater BRUCELM DIAMOND HARRY ROCKS BRIDGELLA. 2 Harradine MANDYSET I SHOT THE SHERIFF. Balanced, free moving, good ribs, well boned.

Class 8 POST GRADUATE DOG (9).1 Mottishaw UPPERWOOD BLUE PRINT. Very pleasing young dog, correct neck and shoulders, good front, bone, feet and pasterns, deep brisket, good ribs, free mover with correct drive & front extension in profile, lovely coat & condition. 2.Ball& Morgan GEMASETT I AM LEGEND. Lovely head, eyes and expression. Good front, bone & feet, well ribbed up, moved well. 3. Goutorbe UPPERWOOD SIGNATURE BY REDHARA

Class 9 LIMIT DOG (5).1 Loakes GOLDBIRCH GUYS N DOLLS JW. Lovely head, eye & expression, balanced, deep brisket, strong topline, good spring of rib, strong quarters, moved freely & soundly. 2 Arkley HARTSETT POETRY IN MOTION. Balanced, well boned, strong pasterns, good spring of rib, medium length with short level back, strong quarters, free mover. 3 Tucker WALSHAW MOONSTORM JW

Class 10 OPEN DOG ((6).1 & CC Sayers & Dennis SH CH MARIGLEN BLUE FLAME FOR CHRISTTER. Lovely head with correct eye & expression, balanced, clean outline, an elegant dog with correct bone, deep brisket, correct width of chest, strong bone, good feet & ribs, strong quarters & topline, moved freely and soundly. 2.& RCC Goutorbe REDHARA BOBBY DAZZLER JW. Pushed hard, again lovely shape d head, strong neck & front, good bone, deep brisket, strong topline, good ribs & quarters. Such a sound free mover. Lost a shade of condition since I made him RBIS at Setter & Pointer the other week. 3rd Kirsch SHINING STAR OF SORBUS
Class 11 SPECIAL BEGINNERS DOG (2). 1. Salmon BURLEYCOTT IRISH CREAM. Balanced free moving dog.
Valerie Foss
SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY November 2010 Bitches
I thoroughly enjoyed my day and would like to thank the committee for their kind hospitality and express my appreciation to the exhibitors for their entry and time taken preparing their setters.

This year one large ring enabled exhibitors to show their dogs first followed by a short interval and then the bitches. Although my entry was perhaps small in numbers quality was high. My overall winner, in my opinion, possessed breed type with fitness and finish. I was pleased to see her awarded Best In Show along with my Best Veteran Bitch - Best Veteran in Show and the Best Puppy Bitch - Best Puppy in Show.
Minor Puppy Bitch 1 entry. 1st Dale's Moorbrook Little Mermaid at Laurelset. Pleasing head, good eye, well bodied for age, moved OK.

Puppy Bitch 7 entries. 1st Goutorbe's Upperwood Snowball for Redhara. What a stylish puppy, plenty of work in head darkest of eyes, clean neck and shoulders, short coupled with good width and bend of stifle, an extrovert mover, once settled she carried herself well, high head with good tail action. Best Puppy in Show. 2nd .Sykes Daraquist By Jingo. Good head and eye, reachy neck, well laid shoulders, good bone, spring of rib and body, angulated quarters, shown in good coat, moved soundly. 3rd Tompsett's Radbrooks Kokomo
Veteran Bitch 3 entries

1st Dennis's Sh Ch Fenston Arabella at Mariglen, Lovely bitch, still possesses all her attributes that has made her the Show Champion she is, good head and eye, overall well balanced throughout, moved out well with drive, in good coat and condition a credit to her owner- Best Veteran in Show. 2nd Scott's Halliana Theme for a Dream Among Seashadows Good head, dark eyes, overall pleasing body properties, moved soundly. 3rd Davis's Merleycopse Love of a Lady

Junior Bitch 3 entries 1 absent 1st Littlechild's Ravensett Blondie. Attractive bitch, pretty head and kind expression, clean neck and shoulders, well off for bone, good depth of chest and spring of rib, strong quarters, moved with drive and good head carriage. 2nd Day's Mandyset Rumour Has It. Pretty head, dark eyes, good neck and shoulders, good depth of chest, moved soundly, a little more coat will complete the picture.
Yearling Bitch 5 entries

1st Lawson's Mariglen Ice Crystal JW. Quality bitch, maturing nicely, feminine head with dark eyes, very elegant in outline, reachy neck with well laid shoulders, good height on the leg, depth of chest and spring of rib, strong angulated quarters, moved with high head carriage and level top line, shown in good coat and condition. 2nd .Oliver's Bramstorm Line Dancer. Pleasing head, dark eyes, good neck and shoulders, depth of chest, well bodied, moved OK albeit she had a dead tail. 3rd Seaward's Mandyset Aint Misbehavin
Novice Bitch 1 entry. 1st Seaward's Mandyset Aint Misbehavin, Pretty head, dark eyes, good bone and feet, well bodied, moved more settled in this class.

Graduate Bitch 6 entries 1 absent. 1st Barker's Elmwood Illusion. 2nd.Barker's Elmwood Imagination.Litter sisters first and second in this class - both very feminine in type. I did prefer the overall outline and balance of second but her sister moved out better on the day. 3rd Montgomery's	Radlake Snow Bunting

Post Graduate 6 entries 3 absent . 1st Kelly's Upperwood Co-co Chanel for Richecca. Beautiful bitch, good head soft expression, clean neck and shoulders, good body properties throughout, strong, angulated quarters, moved with drive, shame her tail was dead, well presented and handled. 2nd Scott's Mandyset Maid to Dream Among Seashadows. Pretty head, dark eyes giving soft expressions, well off for bone and body, good bend of stifle, moved OK. 3rd Rockall's Settrenda Golden Fern at Lesnee.

Limit Bitch 6 entries 1 absent. 1st Kelly's Richecca China Doll. Quality bitch, loved everything about her, Pretty head, soft expression, so well balanced throughout , moved with good head carriage, drive and style, Shown in full coat, well presented and handled, pleased to award her Res C.C. 2nd Goutorbe's Upperwood Betty Barclay - Another quality bitch, good head, neck and shoulders, correct short back with level top line, well set on tail, excellent back end, moved out with drive. Lots to like about her. 3rd Reith's Ownways Touch n Tell

Open 6 entries 1 absent 1st Morgan & Bott's Sh.Ch. Quensha Little Jeanie JW. Feminine head with good kind expression, overall well balanced and clean in outline, well up on the leg, moved out covering the ground with a good head carriage, top line and tail action. Today she looked the part - pleased to award her CC and see her go Best in Show. 2nd Darley's Severnsett Dancing Queen. Lovely type of bitch, feminine head, good eye, balanced in outline, good height on the leg, well bodied with good turn of stifle and tail set. Shown in good coat and condition, moved soundly. Strong contender for top honours. 3rd Harris & Dennis's Sh.Ch.Bondgate Evening Star
Special Beginners Bitch 3 entries 1st Lawson's Mariglen Ice Crystal JW. 2nd Seaward's Mandyset Aint Misbehavin. 3rd Davis's Culverwell Calypso of Merleycopse.
Val Watkin Judge

pages.title: show critique 2011
blocks: Southern English Setter Society Championship Show 20/11/2011
I was honoured to be asked to judge dogs at this friendly well run show. The hard working officers and committee made the day very enjoyable and the hospitality was second to none.
MINOR PUPPY DOG (5)
1.LENZI’S PILSON FLASH HARRY orange belton very good head and eye. 7 month with good body properties. Well constructed with good front, bone and feet, strong hindquarters. Moved soundly.

2.BURT’S RICHECCA SUNSHINE SUPERMAN FOR ABBEYSETT orange belton with a pleasing head and eye. Needs to develop in forechest. Strong topline. Tailset a little low. Well angulated hindquarters. Movement difficult to asses.
PUPPY DOG (5)

1.MOTTISHAN’S UPPERWOOD HOORAY HENRY blue belton with a good head and eye. Well constructed with a pleasing outline. Would like him shorter coupled, standing well on his hindquarters. Moved soundly, well presented. (BEST PUPPY DOG) 2.PILSON FLASH HARRY 3.ATYEO’S HAZEY SUNSETT VIVALDI
VETERAN DOG (2)

1.HAMMOND’S HARTSETT PAPER SKYE FOR OAKTRISH orange belton 9 years in first class show condition. Thoroughly enjoyed his day. Pleasing head, eye and expression. Very good forehand well constructed. Lovely outline, strong topline, well held on the move. Positive action front and rear. Very good tail action whilst moving. With the agreement of my co-judge BEST VETERAN IN SHOW.
JUNIOR DOG (4)

1.JOLLEY’S WANSLEYDALE TRIBUTE TO JOLYMORE orange belton. Good head and eye, well constructed and knit together. Strong loin and topline. Well angulated hindquarters. Sound mover, well presented. 2.TOMPSETT’S RADBROOKS HOMEWARD BOUND blue belton. With a very pleasing head and eye. Very good front, legs, bone and feet. Would like him stronger in topline and shorter loin. Very good front action but would like more width behind. 3.WARRINGTON’S CULVERWEN CAUSING CHAOS
YEARLING DOG (5)

1.MURRAY’S HAVANCOURTS MIRACLE 22 months blue belton. With a pleasing head and eye. Good front, bone and feet. Pleasing outline with a strong topline, could have a better tailset. Short coupled loin. Well angulated hindquarters, moved well.
2.WANSLEYDALE TRIBUTE TO JOLYMORE 3.JONES KERRIMERE CATCH A DREAM AT REDBORNSTOKE
NOVICE DOG (4)
1.UPPERWOOD HOORAY HENRY: 2.RADBROOKS HOMEWARD BOUND : 3.HILL’S MANDYSET SLIPPERY CUSTOMER
GRADUATE DOG (2)

1.STEPHENSON’S WISTASTON STARTING SCHOOL AT STEEPLOW orange belton. Masculine head, good eye. Very good front, bone and feet. Pleasing outline, well angulated hindquarters. Well presented, in good coat and body condition. Moved soundly.

2.PEAD’S SPARSETT HEMBURY EXPLORER OF LAKEVIEW light tricolour. With lots to like about him. Very good legs, bone and feet. Strong topline and good tailset. Short coupled loin, strong well angulated hindquarters. Very good muscle tone and body properties. Very positive movement front and rear. Preferred the head of winner.
POST GRADUATE DOG (6)
1.MOTTISHAW’S UPPERWOOD BLUEPRINT. Upstanding blue belton, typical head. Very good outline, strong topline and good tailset. Very good body properties, strong well angulated hindquarters. Moved well.
2.SALMON’S BURLEYCOTT IRISH CREAM orange belton. Very pleasing head and eye, well constructed with a good outline. In good coat, sound mover. 3.THOMPSON’S RAVENSETT RALPH LAUREN
LIMIT DOG (4)

1.SCHONEVILLE’S BALVENIE BUCCANEER blue belton. Upstanding with a good head and expression. Very good front assembly, strong topline and good tailset. Very good depth of chest, well constructed throughout. Sound mover, in good coat and condition. Res CC

2.DARLEY’S SEVERNSETT MASK OF ZORRO light blue belton. Pleasing head, good eye. Well constructed with very good body properties. Excellent front assembly, strong well muscled hindquarters. Very sound positive mover. Well presented in very good coat and show bloom. 3.BRIDGWATER’S BRUCELM DIAMOND HARRY ROCKS BRIDGELLA
OPEN DOG (6)

1.FISHER’S BEECHANGER WAGTAIL J. W.Shcm ornge belton. Pleasing head and expression. Very well constructed and balanced throughout. Very good outline. Lovely shoulderline. Strong, short coupled loin, strong well angulated hindquarters. In super coat and show condition. Scored heavily in both front and rear action. Delighted to award him the CC and with the agreement of my co-judge BEST IN SHOW.

2.MITCHELL’S SUNPRAKE SUMMER BREEZE. Top class orange belton. Lovely head and eye, excellent front, bone and feet. Very good outline. Short coupled loin, well angulated hindquarters, very sound mover with good tail action on the move. When fully mature will trouble the best. 3.HAMMOND’S HARTSETT GOING FOR GOLD WITH OAKTRISH.
Judge: Mrs Penny Williams
Southern English Setter Society
Championship Show Sunday 20th November 2011

Not a big entry but I had some pleasing exhibits to go over. As a Gundog All-Rounder I do not try to out-do the Breed Specialists but aim for a soundly made dog that conforms to the standard and moves well - I hope to get the heads right if I can. The venue is a great hall - but I was glad of Sat-Nav to find it. It was also pleasant to catch up on old friends from the Elstead Club where I trained for 30 years; we always had a good English Setter contingent attending.

One thing that did strike me and needs mentioning - FEET - no gundog's feet should be flat or with thin pads - of which I saw far too many today. I know most of us do not have the opportunity of using our dogs for the job they were designed for - but that does not let us forget and change the shape of the foot that the standard requires.
Minor Puppy Bitch 3 (1ab)

1st Schoneville & Perry's, Balvenie Vee Marieorange belton bitch of 7 months, pleasing headpiece excellent neck set into well laid shoulder , well sprung rib , strong loin and good topline and tailset - well boned legs - just preferred her more positive movement to 2's.

2nd Birch & West's, Hitides Lily Miss Lucie, 6 ½ month orange belton, sweet head, set on good neck, good front angulation - at the moment crabbing in movement, this can be sorted, well sprung rib, good topline and tailset, well boned leg and good feet.
Puppy Bitch 5 (1ab)

1st Harris' Mariglen Gift Wrapped, named Nora Batty, didn't see the wrinkly stockings - Tri coloured of nearly 1 year, Good feminine head, right for age, well made front and rear quarters, well sprung rib, strong loin, topline and good tailset. Well boned legs and tight feet, excellent turn of stifle and well muscled second thigh, in pleasing coat. A sound mover - Best Puppy Bitch & Best Puppy in Show.

2nd Evans and Patterson's, Gillancette Emerald Lady, 10 months orange belton, sweet headed lady, at the moment the rear is more angulated than the front - so she crabs to get the front legs out of the way of the back - this could still straighten up as she continues to grow.. she had excellent rib, loin topline and tailset, good bone and feet.
3rd Atyeo's Hazeysunett Carissimi
Veteran Bitch 4 (3ab)

1st Mitchell & Withey's, Sunsprake Finn's Fantasy With Scratchwood JW, 9 years old orange belton bitch. A really sound mover, pleasing feminine head, with well made angels to front and rear, good spring of rib, strong through the topline, loin and tailset, with good low hocks which she used well. Well boned legs and good feet.
Junior Bitch 4 (3ab)

1st Hewitt's, Bournehouse Solitaire, Tricoloured of 13 months, A really sound mover, whose correct construction showed when I went over her. Pleasing head, excellent neck and forequarters, with good ribs, showing good depth, length and spring - short loin, well made rear quarters, with good turn of stifle and low hock, well bone legs and good feet, in pleasing coat.
Yearling Bitch 5 (1ab) 3 seen (2ab)

1st Tompsett's, Radbrooks Homeward Bound - 22 month blue belton, a soundly built young lady, good outline, pleasing head, with very good fore and rear quarters, correct rib, with good depth, spring and length, topline good, loin a little long, good low hocks which she used well, good bone and feet, in good coat.
2nd Hewitt's Bournehouse Solitaire.
3rd Millers Denbysett Midnight Dream
Novice 1 new 2 seen
1st Harris & Dennis', Mariglen Gift Wrapped.

2nd Miller's, Denbysett Midnight Cinders 23 months pleasing head, muzzle could be longer, good neck set into well laid shoulder, upper arm could have more length and angulation, excellent rib, had spring depth and length, good short loin, topline and tailset correct, low hocks, well boned legs and good feet - a little unsure - but came round, very well. A sound mover.
3rd Dales, Moorbrook Little Mermaid at Laurelset.
Graduate 4 new (1ab) 2 seen (1ab)
1st Baker's, MandysetPop Tart, very dark tricoloured , pleasing head, front and rear quarters well made, excellent rib, topline and tailset, best of legs and good tight feet, a very sound mover.
2nd Miller's, Denbysett Midnight Dream, 3rd in Yearling, tri coloured, slightly finer all through, strong topline, tailset, she had well turned stifle and low hocks, well boned legs and good feet.
3rd Tucker's, Walshaw Moonlight and Roses.
Post Graduate Bitch 8 new (3ab) 1 seen.

1st Day's, Mandyset Rumour Has It At Decoverly, orange belton 2 ½ years old, one very good little package. Sweet feminine head, very good angulation to front and rear quarters, well made through the rib, loin topline and tailset. Very sound mover on good legs and feet, in excellent coat. Pulled her out for consideration for top awards.

2nd Cozens, Mandyset Blue Murder at Earldoms, blue belton of 2 ½ years, well made forequarters 1's a little better, well constructed through the body with good rib, loin topline and tailset, in good coat and a sound mover.
3rd Miller's, Denbysett Midnight Orders.
Limit 9 new (5ab)

1st Littlechild's Ravensett Blondie JW, orange belton of 2 ½ years old, neat size very good package, good feminine head, excellent fore and rear quarters , good ribs, strong topline and loin, good tailset, well turned stifle and good second thigh, best of movers on good legs and feet in grand coat. Pulled her out for consideration for top awards.

2nd Evans', Manorroy Mandarin Lady at Gillancette, orange belton of 4 years, more upstanding not quite the outline of 1, good head, neck and lay of shoulder, excellent rib topline and loin, moved out well on good legs and feet, in very good coat.
3rd Davis', Culverwell Calypso of Merleycopse.
Open Bitch 5 (1ab) - only class who all had good feet.

1st Morgan & Bott's, Sh Ch Quensha Little Jeanie JW, orange belton of 3 ½ years, beautiful outline topped by gentle feminine head, neck flowed into well made forequarters, ribs had good spring, depth and length, loin and topline strong. Good tailset, well muscled rear quarters with excellent stifle and good second thigh, soundest of movers on good legs and feet, very well set down and looking a picture. .

2nd Dennis', Sh Ch Mariglen Francesca Fenston, orange belton of 4 ½ years old - I believe I said of her as a puppy "Moves with aplomb" - she still does nearly 4 years on - great balanced outline - slightly stronger in head piece, but still beautiful, good neck set into well made forequarters, great angles in the rear, with super stifle, good second thigh and low hock, well made through the body, a very sound mover on well made legs and feet, in the best of coats. Bitch Reserve CC.
3rd Darley's, Sh Ch Severnsett Dancing Queen.

pages.title: show critique 2012
blocks: Southern English Setter Society Championship Show
18th November 2012 Judge; Mrs Jill Kelly
Dogs
Minor Puppy (8)

1.Mr&Mrs.J.W, Watkin's Valsett Starlite Up'N'Shine well grown orange, of good size and substance. Excellent bone and body, well angulated forehand with matching quarters. Strong level topline and correct tailset. Moved sound and true.

2.Mrs S Dales Upperwood Summertime Blues Really liked this puppy, he has the most beautiful head and soft expression, well placed shoulders and lovely reach of neck, good body, not quite the rear angulation of 1 or the coat as yet but a very promising puppy. Moved really well.
3.Mr &Mrs GW Fisher's Beechanger Dusty Miller
PUPPY (5)

1.Mrs A. Derry& Mr P Schonvilles Balvenie Clandestine I was very impressed with this elegant youngster he is so together for his age, lovely clean outline with no exaggerations, classic head and gentle expressive eyes. Correct bone and carrying just the right amount of weight. Moved really well . Best Dog Puppy

2.Mrs P Harris's Culverwell First Footer into Konakakela Nice type. Orange with pleasing head and dark eye, well angulated and has good bone and feet. Needs to firm up in topline and front but overall another promising puppy. Moved well
3 Mrs J Lynn's.Culverwell Captain Jack.
Veteran (5)

1. Mr&Mrs D Kirsch's Shining Star of Sorbus An old favourite of mine, such a sound well made dog he presents a beautiful outline with elegance and substance combined. At 91/2 years he still retains his quality head and dark expressive eyes. Outmoved most here today, such a shame he never gained his title. BVIS
2. Mr M Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire Dark blue upstanding male in full coat, well angulated fore and aft. Excellent bone and body. Loved his typyness. Unfortunately not as positive on the move as 1.
3. Mrs C J Tuckers Walshaw Moonstorm
Junior (2)

1. Mrs W &Miss K Whittington's Juldean Excalibur.Eyecatching youngster. Tricolour with classy head and dark eye, reachy neck and excellent shoulder placement, short level back and well bent stifles. Correct level topline and tailset. At the" inbetween stage" at the moment but with time and patience im sure will mature into a top flight dog.

2.Mrs B. Feerick's Cannonsett Falling in love. Nicely made Tri, with attractive head and soft expression. Well off for bone. Well bodied. Not cooperating with his handler today and didn't move with any enthusiasm.More attention needed to presentation otherwise a very nice dog.
Yearling(7)
1.Mrs W&Miss K. Whittingtons Juldean Excalibur

2.Mrs C Mottishaws Upperwood Hooray Henry.Stylish Blue with good reach of neck and well placed shoulders.Well ribbed. Strong loin and excellent hind angulation.Short hocks round bone and good feet. Maturity just right for age. Overall a pleasing picture, I just preferred head of 1.
3.Mrs E Birch& Mrs C West Hitides Gingerbreadman
Novice (2)
1,Mrs P Harris's Culverwell First Footer into Konakakela
2.Mrs B Feerick's Cannonsett Falling in Love
Graduate (1)
1. Miss B Pead's Sparsett Hembury Explorer Alone.Well presented lightTri. Sweet head and expression. Short coupled, nice tight feet, short hocks. Moved OK.
Post Graduate (4)

1. Mrs NJ. Shadwell's Canonsett Grin 'N' Bear It.Quality Blue with attractive head and dark expressive eyes. Well placed shoulders and strong level topline, good depth to chest. Well bent stifles short hocks and tight feet. Moved really well using his tail
2. Mr M.Slack's Ravensett Renaissance Dark Blue with strong masculine head, reachy neck adequate shoulders,well angulated quarters, unfortunately lacking a little condition today. Moved OK
3 Miss A Salmon's Burleycott Irish Cream
Limit (9)
A really good ciass with the first 3 all in contention and very difficult to separate.

1. Mrs R.j Crofts Fencefoot Fond Memory JW. Top quality , sound honest dog with no exaggerations. Classic head with dark eye and melting expression. Correct forehand, firm level topline and strong well angulated quarters. Carrying just the right amount of condition today. Moved with drive and purpose. Fully mature and deserving of his title. CC and BIS

2. Ms M Withey and F Mitchells Sunsprake Raging Storm over Scratchwood JW very close up to 1 and similar comments apply, just not quite as ready but almost there and I am sure it wont be long before he gains his title. I particularly liked his refined head and kindly eye, well placed shoulders and straight front He presents a balanced elegant outline. Moved really well. RCC
3.Mrs &Miss Hackings Benrae Royal Variety.
Open (4)

I was delighted to have the opportunity to go over these 4 show champions and would like to thank their owners for bringing them. They all have the quality and characteristics that our breed require and I made my decisions based on how they looked on the day.

1. Mr & Mrs J W Watkins SH CH Wansleydale Rowanberry Of Valsett, Quality orange, on top form today. Strong masculine head, compact body, well angulated quarters excels in movement and won this class with his sound driving action. In fabulous coat and condition, shown faultlessly as always by this exhibitor.

2. Mr & Mrs G Fishers SH CH Beechanger Wagtail JW, very close decision, however felt 1 was in slightly better bloom today and had the edge in movement. Rangier male, well angulated forehand and good reach of neck, deep brisket and strong quarters, Well presented and handled.
3.Mrs S D Loakes SH CH Goldbirch Guys and Dolls JW ShCM
Special Beginners
1.Mrs W & MissK Whittingtons Juldeane Excalibur
2.Mrs N J Shadwells Cannonsett Grin 'N' Bear It
3.Miss A Salmons Burleycott Irish Cream

BITCHES - It was a shame there was so many absentees. Final decisions were in agreement with my co-judge.
MP (5, 2a) Three promising puppies.
1 Mr & Mrs J.W. Watkin, VALSETT STARLITE UPSY DAISY 7 mths light tri, attractive head, well put together, good balance of body, good bone and feet, steady movement for one so young.
2 Miss L Harris, GEMSETT ULTRA VIOLET 6 mths dark blue, very much the baby, sweet head and expression, lovely angulated shoulders and back end, gave way to 1 on movement and maturity.

pages.title: show critique 2013
blocks: Southern English Setter Society-Bitches
17th November 2013
I would like to thank the society giving me the opportunity to judge at their Championship Show. I was also very grateful to receive the good entry that I did.

One thing I must say was quite noticeable was just how many exhibits had light eyes which are really taking away the softness of the expression that our breed should have. On another negative, and this was only really in the younger classes was an awful lot of high tail actions. I would forgive this more in a male but there is no reason for bitch's to be doing it!
On the positive mouths seemed not too bad and temperaments were what is expected of our breed.
MPB 6 (2 AB)

1st Montell's, Culverwell Calamity Jane. Really well put together tri with lots of promise. Lovely markings. Correct shaped head. Really well balanced for a youngster, stacked and on the move. well handed. BPB. Lost out to a really good dog pup for BPIS. 2nd Colville's, Arabin Top Secret. Tri with really good bone and substance. A little hesitant on the move for a start but went better the more she moved. Everything is in the right place but needs to tone up a little in particular her topline. 3rd Montell's, Culverwell Rosy Dawn.
PB 9 entries (4 ab)

1st Stephenson & William's Lakecastle Sakura at Wistaston .Smart eye catching orange. Really well proportioned head and dark eye although eyes a little round for my liking but still had the desired soft expression. Balanced throughout and moved soundly. Won the class well. . 2nd Stirk's Twyline Truly Skysablaze Over Grakar Dark orange. Stunning headed girl with a lot to like but sadly carrying far too much weight which spoilt her overall balance. Did however move well despite her weight. 3rd Montell's, Culverwell Rosy Dawn.
VB 3 entries (1 Ab)

1st Deerings, Rosetimber Foxy Lady. Blue who's still thinks she's a pup. Bombed round the ring with drive and style with lashing tail. Not the head I would go for but this could not deny her the class. 2nd Mortimer's, Marlowsett Colour My Life at Phlerdor SHCM A tri that has been a favourite of mine for many years. So sorry to say she was favouring a leg on the move today.
JB 6 Entries (3 ab)

1st Collis & Passey's, Richecca Fallen Angel. Beautifully put together o/b. Still a long way to go for all the finishing but won the class for soundness, especially on the move. I will be very interested to see her again once she's bodied up. 2nd Carlin's, Sodalitas Silent Witness. B/B with the most stunning head and expressive eyes. Good angulation throughout. Sadly today was lacking coat which spoilt her balance. Needs to shed a few lbs too as it is affecting her topline. 3rd Davis', Richecca Baby Doll of Merleycopse
YB 5 6 entries (2 ab)

The first three bitch's in this class are of the highest order. 1st Montell's, Culverwell Christabelle B/b for which stole the day for me. If I had to bitch one exhibit t take home with me on the day, she would be my choice. Everything I wish to see in the breed, from temperament to soundness. I seriously considered giving her higher honours but her best is still to come. 2nd Watkins, Valsett Starlite Upsy Daisy. Beautifully marked tri. Very different in type to 1 but still very sound. I loved her length of muzzle as so many other exhibits were short in foreface. If I had to change anything I would want her eyes darker. Her angulation both front and rear is to be admired though. 3rd Darley's, Bournehouse Water Music at Sevensett
NB 3 Entries (2 Ab)
1st Collis & Passey's, Richecca Fallen Angel.
GB 5 Entries (4 ab)

1st Weller's, Juldeane Morgan Fay. B/b in really firm condition. Good strong head without losing femininity. Dark expressive eyes. Long strong neck leading into well laid back shoulders. Moved soundly and effortlessly around the ring. I'd like to see her in more coat.
PGB 12 Entries (2 Ab)

1st Swannell's, Rickory Bizzie Lizzie Top quality Tri in perfect firm show condition. Stunning head and dark eyes with melting expression. Strong level top line. Moved with drive and lashing tail. Fabulous hind quarters. Came so close for the CC today. Must be destined for her title. Res CC. 2nd Grimsdell's, Tattersett Frankel JW Another quality bitch. B/B shown today in superb condition. Like 1 she is nicely balanced both stood and on the move. Must have a bright future. For me though I preferred the head and eye of 1. Her positives still outweigh her negatives. 3rd Rumble's, Jotuheim Va Va Voom
LB 10 Entries (3 Ab)

1st Hartle's Hartsett Cherry Bee JW. I've seen this O/B look better than she did today but it is a credit to how good she is that she could still win a strong limit class whilst not at her best. Stunning head and dark eyes with sweet expression. Great barrel of rib and really made well throughout. Moved really soundly but not so enthusiastic for some reason. 2nd Loynd's, Richecca Sea the Stars at Crimbledale. Cracking B/B with bags of appeal. I very nearly gave her the class but she's still some way off the finished article yet. I would love to meet her again after a litter and firmer condition. For type she is everything I look for. 3rd Carlin's, Wynacre Last Tango For Sodalitas
OB 6 Entries (1 Ab)
1st Watkins, Valsett Starlite Rosy Moon

O/B that totally shocked me today. I have to be honest and say she is a bitch I have never really taken much notice of before. The saying that every dog has it's day is very fitting in this case. She ticked every box for me and certainly deserved the CC and with agreement from my Co Judge Best In Show. On today's performance it surely cannot be long until she gains her title. Presented perfectly. Well done to all concerned. 2nd Cook's, Moorbrook Uptown Flirt at Pernickety. Another top Quality O/B. So Much to like about her. Long clean neck leading to well angulated shoulders. Strong Top line. Good hind quarters which she used so well on the move. For me preference however I did find her head and expression just not quite feminine enough, but that's just a personally preference thing. I liked her a lot. 3rd Grimsdell's, Tattersett Doctor In Love
SBB 4 Entries (2 ab)

1st Davis's, Richecca Baby Doll of Merleycorpse. A Tri which was an absolute fidget! Plenty of substance and bone. For the few seconds that she stood still she looked very balanced. Moved well. 2nd Kerr's, Fanchon Lawby Miss Clawdy Taffi (imp) A very strong headed b/b. Very different in type. Shown in lots of coat and condition. Very well handled. It will be interested to see how she develops.
Bitches
Southern English Setter Championship show 17th November 2013 held at Tadley, Hampshire.

I was somewhat surprised and disappointed at how much the majority of the English Setters have changed and unfortunately not for the better. The standard asks for bright, mild and expressive oval eye. I saw plenty of dogs with round protruding eyes which totally changes the soft melting expression we used to expect from the breed. Feet also seem to be a problem, again very few have the well padded tight feet with close well arched toes. And shoulders, well I could probably count on one hand the dogs that actually had the correct layback of shoulder with good return of upper arm. Upright shoulders and short upper arm seem to be the order of the day and this does hinder the movement, a dog cannot reach in front with a short upper arm and incorrect shoulders. On the upside I was pleased with my winners there are nice examples about so please think carefully before breeding.
Dogs
Minor Puppy (5)

1st - Trigwell & Weller - Hannahdene Danny Boy - At 9 months this orange dog has an exciting time ahead of him. I loved him, he has the most beautiful head and eye with melting expression. Stands on good legs and the best of feet, correct rounded bone, superb neck and correct layback of shoulder with length of upper arm. Excellent topline with a good tail set. Lovely bend of stifle and moved really well for one so young driving from his super hindquarters. Delighted my co-judge and I were unanimous in the decision to give him Best Puppy In Show. I shall look forward to watching his progress in the future.

2nd - Gilbert - Brucelm Wykhill at Shadowood - Giving a lot away in age and maturity but has a lot of potential. He has a lovely head and eye with good neck and shoulders, level topline, just needs to tidy up on the move.
3rd - Penn - Culverwell Golden Glory
Puppy (3)

1st - Hodge - Lakecastle Tomo - Gave this dog's dam her first CC and she has passed her qualities on to her son. Lovely head and eye with good layback of shoulder, well constructed all through . Good legs and feet correct topline. Although naughty he has potential. Unfortunate to meet the minor puppy on such good form.
2nd - Bennet - Mariglen Blue Star - Could not match the head and expression of the winner, lovely coat and condition.
3rd - Feerick - Canonsett Highland Mist
Veteran (5)

1st - Taylor - Sh Ch Wansleydale Royal Flush JW - Beautiful head on this orange dog, well balanced, excellent neck and shoulders, retains his topline at all times and he moves so well. Shown in super coat & condition Best Veteran In Show
2nd - Dunks- Samelen One Man - Unlucky to meet 1. Lovely head and expression, good legs and feet, excellent topline, well held tail on the move.
3rd - Hammond - Hartsett Going for Gold with Oaktrish
Junior (8)(2)

1st - Mellish - Gemsett Pole Position for Monbrec - Blue dog, naughty but nice 17 month with a beautiful head and expression, lovely front end assembly, good topline. Excellent bone, nice tail and set. Moved well.
2nd - Kirsch - Sorbus Hugo Boss - orange of a different type to 1. Good head, neck & shoulders, excellent topline nicely angulated rear quarters, just tended to get his tail up on the move.
3rd - Whitehorn - Upperwood Summer Sky of Wennvale
Yearling (7)(2)
1st - Thompsett - Radbrooks God Only Knows - Smaller build than 2 but balanced all through, nice head and eye, good front, level topline, in good coat and condition, moved well enough.
2nd - Schoneville & Derry - Balvenie Clandestine JW - balanced tri nicely put together, good topline, excellent legs and feet.
3rd - Harris - Culverwell First Footer into Konakakela
Novice (6)(1)
1st - Mellish - Gemsett Pole Position for Monbrec
2nd - Kirsch - Sorbus Hugo Boss
3rd - Neath - Albadora Remember Me
Graduate (5)

1st - Watts - Jotunheim Limited Edition - Blue dog of lovely type with a good neck and shoulders, would like a little more return of upper arm. Clean neck, level topline. Could do to loose a couple of pounds.
2nd - Whittington - Juldeane Excalibur - tri of a lighter frame than 1 but substantial, lovely head and eye, longer cast than 1.
3rd - Warrington - Culverwell Causing Chaos
Post Graduate (7)

1st - Mortimer - Phlerdor Thief of Time - Smaller built dog but balanced all through, lovely head and eye, good neck and shoulders, level topline, shown in lovely coat and condition. Looked a picture standing could have done with a bit more drive but it may have had something to do with the limited space. RCC
2nd - Jolley - Wansleydale Tribute to Jolymore - different type to 1 but lots to like, nicely put together, another lovely dog.
3rd - Pead - Sparsett Hembury Explorer of Lakeview
Limit (5)(2)

1st - Taylor - Wansleydale King of Hearts at Bramstorm - This breeder seems to keep getting it right and produces quality time and time again. Standing this dog has everything in the right place, beautifully constructed, the best of neck flowing into correct shoulders, excellent return of upper arm, level topline, excellent legs and feet correct bone, short coupled, beautiful rear angulation and super on the move. If I was being hyper-critical I would like a little less back skull and his tail tends to creep up on the move, but nothings perfect. Still delighted to award him the CC and I understand this was his 3rd. Congratulations Reserve Best In Show.

2nd -Stephenson - Wistaston Starting School at Steeplow. Another nice dog, longer cast than the winner and consequently not as strong in topline. He moved out well and did keep his tail down. Unlucky to meet 1.
3rd - Mottishaw - Upperwood Hooray Henry
Open (5)(2)
1st - Darley - Severnsett Mask of Zorro- Balanced dog, profusely coated, he has a lovely head and eye, good front, level topline, good tail and set.
2nd - Schoneville & Derry - A dog I have previously awarded the RCC, but today he was not at his best, good tail and set, nails could do with some attention.
3rd - Colville & McLoughlin - Arabin Midnight Breeze
Special Beginners (4)
1st - Whittington - Juldeane Excalibur
2nd - Pead - Sparsett Hembury Explorer of Lakeview
3rd - Watts - Jotunheim Limited Edition
Judge : Ruth Martin
Southern English Setter Society
17th November 2013
Suntop Memorial Stakes (12.5abs)

1st Taylor's Sh Ch Wansleydale Royal Flush. Upstanding Orange dog, presents a clean outline, masculine head with soft expression, excellent bone and feet. Deep well ribbed body, short coupled. Good strong backend with well bent stifles, and let down hocks. Moved sound and true with driving action and slashing tail.

2nd Darley's Bournehouse Water Music at Severnsett, Blue bitch, with feminine head, dark eye, straight front, would prefer cleaner shoulders, very good depth of body and spring of rib, level topline, short coupled and excellent tailset, moved soundly
3rd Watts' Jotunheim Limited Edition

pages.title: show critique 2014
blocks: SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY
CHAMPIONSHIP SHOW SUNDAY 16TH NOVEMBER 2014
DOGS:

I would like to thank the Society for their very welcome hospitality and special thanks to my very abled stewards. I thoroughly enjoyed my appointment but feel that careful attention, in my opinion, should be directed to the all too common gay tails that seem prevalent in the breed, which so much spoil a Setter in movement and also to the rather ‘alien’ large flat feet, instead of those tight well arched toes the breed should have. Both of these elements detract from the elegant Setter we look for in both appearance and movement. However overall I was very pleased with the quality of the entry.

MPD (3) 1. Jones Kerrimer Sing the Blues for Redbornstoke. Very attractive upstanding 8 month old tri, plenty of work to head, kind expression, good round bone, to be expected at this age needs to tighten in front, pleasing outline, level top line, a little more weight would be to his advantage, but moved true, fore and aft, in super coat and condition.

2. Osmans Bournehouse Star Gazer at Marissolo. 6 month baby of great substance, shown in good coat and condition, well ribbed, deep body, again needs to tighten in front, attractive masculine head, kind expression, lean neck, correct bend of stifle which enabled him to move well, using his tail correctly.
3. Parkers Hannahdene Red Jasper.

PD: (6.2) 1. Morgan & Botts Quensha Back to the Future. Most attractive dark tri who presented a very pleasing outline when stood, head is a little unbalanced at present, deep flews with skull needing to develop and balance up, time on his side, kind expressive eyes, clean neck into well laid back shoulders, short back, good bend of stifle, tail set well on, shown in lovely hard condition and covered the ground well with slashing tail. BPD

2. Dales Beechanger Night Hawk Over Laurelset. This orange has the most appealing head, with soft expression, lean neck into well laid back shoulders, level top line, deep body, good second thigh, movement was good and sound but a little proud of his tail.
3. Jones Kerrimere Sing the Blues for Redbornstoke.

VETERAN: I compliment the veterans on their presentation and condition. (3) 1. Jolleys Sh Ch Wansleydale Loganberry at Jolymore ShCM. I do have a soft spot for this striking dark blue but he did not win this class on sentiment, he moved the best I have ever seen, really on his toes. Well chiselled head, soft expression, wonderful round bone with the tightest of feet, toes well arched, well ribbed and deep in body, short coupled, in full coat, moved with slashing tail. BVIS

2. Wrights Sh Ch Fishwick Dancing Lad. This orange carries his title well, refined head, kind expression, good body properties, lean neck into good layback of shoulder, deep body, again in very good coat but just did not put all into his moving today.
3. Salmons Burleycott Irish Cream.

JUNIOR: A good class. (7.1) 1. Colliers Gamerights Mr Blue Sky at Roszarke (Imp Bel). This elegant 16 mth blue presented a clean outline, most lovely lean head yet retaining masculinity, kind expression, excels in straight front, bone and feet, carrying the correct amount of weight, strong clean neck into well laid back shoulder, level back, good bend of stifle, presented in first class order, moving very well using his tail. Should have a bright future.

2. Wale and Baileys Wansleydale Kings Magic. Just 13 mths this light orange presented a lovely flowing outline when stood, slightly fine mould than 1 but perfectly balanced. Refined head, lovely expression, well placed shoulder and straight front, good quarters and tail set. Presented in lovely coat and condition, moved well, another one for the future.
3. Mellishs Walshaw Blinded By Love For Monbrec.

YD: (4) 1. Gilberts Brucelm Wyke Hill at Shodowood. Upstanding orange, refined head which would benefit broadening in the skull to present a more balanced picture, however has kind eye, good round bone, feel well padded, good lay of shoulder, correct turn of stifle, in good coat and condition, correct level tail which he used when moving well.
2. Bennets Mariglen Blue Star. Attractive blue with strong masculine head, strong neck into laid back shoulder, good round bone, slightly longer cast then 1, moved well quite proud of his tail today.
3. Feericks Canonsett Highland Mist.
NOVICE: (7.2) 1. Colliers Gamerights Mr Blue Sky at Roszarke (Imp Bel).
2. Wale & Baileys Wansleydale Kings Magic.
3. Gilberts Brucelm Wykehill at Shodowood.

GRADUATE: Good class. (5.1) 1. Fishers Beechanger Dusty Miller, orange, this substantial honest dog has no exaggerations. Masculine head with soft expression, strong neck flowing into well laid back shoulders, strong level top line, well ribbed, deep body, good bone and padded feet, correct bend of stifle, perfect tail set off the back which he used correctly moving with verve to take the class. In the challenge he just seemed to be fighting his handler which affected his movement.

2. Urens Bensophie Dark Crystal. This beautifully presented light blue has certainly come on. Finer mould than 1 but perfectly balanced, he has the most appealing yet masculine head, kind expression, clean, lean neck into well laid back shoulders, straight front, well set on tail which he used when he moved sound and true around the ring.
3. Mellishs Gemsett Pole Position for Monbrec.

POST GRAD: (9.1) 1. Whittingtons Juldeane Excalibur, a dog unknown to me, but one I really liked. This tri dog has a most lovely refined head, kind expression, long lean neck into good layback of shoulder, deep in body, strong level back, tail excellently set, round bone, tight feet, presented overall a very elegant and balanced picture when stood, good condition and coat and moved out well. In the challenge he just tended to move a little close behind.

2. Osmons Bournehouse Design at Marissolo ShCM. Upstanding blue, masculine head, kind eye, strong neck, deep body, slightly longer cast than 1, presented in good coat and condition, moved well and happily using his tail.
3. Croft & Littlechilds Ravensett Royal Legacy with Thistlesett.

LIMIT (9) Super Class. 1. Kellys Richecca Shades of Grey JW. This very elegant tri just commanded attention when stood, built on such clean flowing lines, refined head, kind expression, long clean neck into well laid back shoulders, good round bone, deep body, level back, well muscled quarters, well set tail, and excellent presentation, shown in full coat completed the picture. Each and every time this dog was asked to move, he never failed to please, long striding, driving off his hocks, straight and true with slashing tail. Privilege to award him I understand his 3rd CC and with my co judge BOB & BIS.

2. Stubbingtons Quensha Oh What a Night at Bondgate. Good honest tri dog, masculine head with the most melting expression, strong neck into well laid back shoulders, straight front, good round bone and padded feet, short compact body, correct tail set, good quality coat, well muscled quarters and once concentrated and settled he moved out freely and effortlessly. This I am sure is the beginning of his best to come RCC.
3. Watts Jotunhein Limited Edition.

OPEN: (3.2) 1. Darleys Sh Ch Severnsett Mask of Zorro. Was indeed a pleasure to go over this very well deserved title holder. Very attractive blue with masculine head, kind eye strong neck into good shoulder layback, well ribbed in fact a little less weight I felt would have been to his advantage, deep body, strong quarters and presented in lovely coat, just did not put his all into moving today.
SPECIAL BEGINNERS: (5) 1. Whittingtons Juldeane Excalibur.
2. Bennets Mariglen Blue Star.
3. Hodges Lakecastle Tomo

Minor Puppy Bitch (1)

1st. ALDRIDGE. GRAKAR STARSTRUCK FOR FLECKERS (NAF TAF) 7 month blue baby, pretty head, moved steadily for one so young, with lashing tail action, just needs to body up which will come with age, sympathetically handled.
Class 13 Puppy Bitch (2.1)

1st. NEATH. Mrs. J - ALBADORA LATE ARRIVAL, what a lovely puppy, mature 9 month old tri, kind gentle expression dark eye, well bodied, rounded bone neat tight feet, moved confidently with a waggy tail, keeping a level topline. BPB and in full agreement with my co judge BPIS.

all absent
Class 15 Junior Bitch (5.2)

1st. TAYLOR. WETHERBY WHISPER TO WANSLEYDALE, lovely type, stunning tri, kind expression low set ears, well bodied and short coupled, well let down hocks, correct angulation fore and aft. Won this class on her true sound movement

2nd. HENRY. - PILSDON FLASHLIGHT, fidgety orange, looked a picture when she would stand still! Heavier in the head than 1, long arched neck into well laid shoulders, loved her shape and flowing outline, and kept a level topline on the move.
3rd. HARRIS. S - SHANANDI HOLLYHOCK FOR KONAKAKELA
Class 16 Yearling Bitch (8.4)

1st. SEAMAN. MARIGLEN MERCEDES JW, flashy blue, she presents a picture of elegance, she is so well balanced, long arched neck set in well laid shoulders, shown in hard muscler condition, moved round the ring with forward reach and driving action hind action.
2nd. TAYLOR. - Wetherby Whisper To Wansleydale
3rd. MONTELL. CULVERWELL CALAMITY JANE
Class 17 Novice Bitch (2.1)
1st. HARRIS. - Shanandi Hollyhock For Konakakela 3rd in a good junior class, pretty headed blue built on longer lines, moved soundly.
Class 18 Graduate Bitch (8.1)

1st. MONTELL. CULVERWELL CHRISTABELLE, Pretty light blue blue, feminine head with a melting expression, dark kind eyes, lean muscular neck into well set back shoulders, moved well driving from her strong hindquarters, shown in good quality coat. She must have a bright future.

2nd. SHARPLES. Mrs. M - KANIETTER SILVER BELLES another pretty blue, I judged her as a puppy, she has developed into a well balanced youngster, just preferred, head and expression of 1, correct lay back of shoulder, shown in full bloom.
3rd. BRYANT. Mr. N.S. & Miss E.M.C. & HOLLIS. - PHENSET RUBY TUESDAY
Class19 Post Graduate Bitch (7.2)

1st.MORGAN. & BOTT - QUENSHA SHADOWS OF THE NIGHT JW, Flashy dark tri, sound happy mover, with lovely lashing tail action, good front & rear, hocks well let down, shown in hard condition, just needs furnishings to complete the picture.
2nd. STIRK. - RAVENSETT SUZANNAH VIA GRAKAR, pretty headed blue, pushed 1 hard, kind expression with dark eyes, low set ears, moved well driving from sound hind quarters.
3rd. DYTE - VALSETT STARLITE UP'N' ROSIE
Class 20 Limit Bitch (10.1) best class of the day

1st. JENNINGS. - CANTERIS CARELESS WHISPER, today was her day, I have never seen her looking so well, I couldn't take my eyes off her, she is the finished article, honest flashy coloured orange bitch with no exaggerations, beautifully headed with the darkest expressive eyes, melting expression, oval skull, low set ears, clean and elegant neck into well laid shoulders, well ribbed correct body, strong rear which she used on the move. Flowed round the ring using her tail to advantage. Shown in full coat and firm condition. Thrilled to award her the CC & RBIS (in full agreement with for Co judge), hope the other 2 aren't so far away.

2nd. TAYLOR. - WANSLEYDALE SCARLET RIBBON JW, Stunning blue unlucky to meet 1 looking so good. Loved her shape and clean outline. Long strong arched neck, to correct shoulders, short coupled and deep in brisket,level tailset, stylish sound mover, using her tail advantage.
3rd. TOMPSETT. Miss F - RADBROOKS KOKOMO
Class 21 Open Bitch (5.3)

1st. DENNIS. SH. CH. MARIGLEN XANTHE JW, She was my Bp last time I judged, she fills the eye with her quality, stunning Orange, fabulous expression, she still has a look of devilment in her eyes, elegant neck into well placed shoulders, well sprung ribs, correct angulation fore & aft, I could watch her move all day, drives away with lashing tail. RCC
2nd. U'REN. Hollygrove Tumble At Bensophit, Honest pretty headed orange shown in good coat and condition.
Class 22 Special Beginners Bitch (4,1)
1st. SEAMAN. - Mariglen Mercedes Jw
2nd. KERR. - Fanchon Lawdy Miss Clawdy Taffi (imp.nld) Blue enjoying her day out, moved with driving action, keeping a level topline, unfortunately a bit proud of her tail.
3rd. DAVIS. Mrs. Y. - RICHECCA BABY DOLL OF MERLEYCOPSE
The Southern English Setter Society (Championship Show) 16th November 2014.
Judge: Joan Trigwell. (Hannahdene)
Class: Suntop Memorial Award. Entries: 12. Absent 1.

I would like to 'thank' everyone for entering this special 'Suntop Memorial Class' under me and for giving me a variety of different ages to go over. I enjoyed the show and hospitality of all concerned. 'Thank You'

1st. Taylor's - Wetherby Whisper to Wansleydale. What a pretty Dark Tri bitch, she caught my eye when entering the ring and did not disappoint, when I went over her. Only 15 months old, with good confirmation throughout. Dark eye, clean neck, good spring of ribs and just the right amount of bone, very feminine. Tight feet, good topline and tailset, which she kept on the move, was a pleasure to watch. She won a very strong class of different aged entries. Well done.
2nd. Whittington's - Juldeane Excalibur, 3rd. Darley's Sh Ch Severnsett Mask Of Zorro. 4th Tompsett's Radbrooks Kokomo. 5th. Jolley's Wansleydale Tribute To Jolymore.
Joan Trigwell.
