pages.title: show critique 2019
blocks: Southern English Setter Society
17th November 2019
DOGS
A pleasure to judge our wonderful breed at such a well organised show. My co-judge, Neil Kelly and I fully agreed on the major awards.

Best In Show was the BCC winner, Taylor's Sh Ch Wansleydale Queen Bee, super example of our breed looking well and presented in first class order. Reserve Best In Show was my DCC winner, Schoneville and Derry's Hawklawn Khamsin at Balvenie, Best Puppy In Show went to the PB, Pitts' Wandsfell Dream Maker and Best Veteran to the VD, Colton's Sodalitas High Havoc over Ennydloc
Minor Puppy (1)

1 Parrish's Tawnymeade Tranquil Waters .8 months tri. Well grown and coming along nicely. Balanced in head with good length of muzzle. Straight, well boned front. Good depth for his age. Well set tail. Moved steadily.
Puppy (1)
1 Parrish's Tawnymeade Tranquil Waters
Veteran (6, 2 absent)
Lovely class headed by two quality orange boys.

1 Colton's Sodalitas High Havoc over Ennydloc At nine years old is balanced and well bodied for his age. Good head with strong neck of good length and well laid shoulders. Well developed ribs with width and depth. Strong over his quarters. He has a good turn of stifle and moved well here. Pleased that my co judge agreed to him being Best Veteran in Show. 2 Hepburn's Tattersett Don't Push It Close up. I have liked this one before - and still do! Super head, elegant and refined but still masculine. Clean in neck with good layback of shoulder. Good depth of body and firm over his couplings. He has a good turn of stifle and hocks are well let down. Just not a positive on the move as the winner today.
3 Mellish's Gemsett Pole Position for Monbrec
Junior (3,1)

1 Taylor's Bumblecorn Ash of Tattay Coming together slowly but still plenty to like here. Refined in head with clean neck of good length. Well boned straight front. Level topline. Short form hock to heel. He just needs time to develop and fill out. 2 Kelly's Cornsett The Wise One Stronger made 15 month old in good coat. Good shoulder angulation and depth to his body. Well boned through with hocks let down nicely. Tricky decision.
Yearling (5,1)

1 Phillips, Bryant and Watkins' Glenmaurangi Star Man Well balanced and in good muscular order. Balanced head with kind expression and good ear placement. Good depth and width of chest giving the essential heart room. Strong quarters with good width of thigh. Handled to advantage. Should go on to do well. 2 Taylor and Ateo's Samelin Comeback Special Just 18 months and lacking the finish of the winner but that shouldn't decry from his many qualities. Classic head with clean neck. Well rounded bone. Good length of rib. Needs to fill out but that will come. Level topline, well angulated quarters complete a lovely outline. Moved well in profile. 3 Bryant and Hollis' Silvamoon Storm Trooper for Phenset
Novice (1)
1 Kelly's Cornsett The Wise One
Graduate (4)

1 Normansell's Latin Lover Rewind for Larrenie This dark blue has a clean elegant outline. Balanced head with good reach of neck. No throatiness here. He is firm in topline with good width over his loins. He moved well going away from me. Tail never stopped wagging. A happy boy who will only get better with maturity. 2 Worthy's Tattersett Big Orange Good headed orange boy with well defined stop and gentle expression. Well bone through. Strong in neck with well developed ribs and strength over his short loins. Hocks are well let down. Moved steadily. Carrying plenty of body. 3 Full's Ravensett The Midas Touch at Teignestuary
Post Grad (8,2)

1 Harris, Bridgewater and Hoeksema's Bridgella First Edition with Konakakela One I have noticed from the ring side and is as good to go over. Balanced in head with dark eyes and soft expression. Clean neck of good length. He is well developed in chest with good depth and length to his ribs. Quarters are well angulated. He moved soundly when settled holding his topline well. Well presented in good coat and condition. Looked well. 2 Lawson's Wansleydale Dorian Grey Not as forward as the winner but is beginning to develop along the right lines. Good head with dark eyes and correct ear placement. Firm in topline with well angulated quarters He was in super hard condition and moving true both ways. Just needs the maturity to finish the picture. 3 Brown's Mariglen Night Manager at Yendorlech
Limit (6,1)

1 Schoneville and Derry's Hawklawn Khamsin at Balvenie This three year old orange is really looking well now. Refined head with good balance, length of muzzle and a kind expression. Clean neck of good length leads to straight well boned front. He is deep in chest and strong over the loins giving a correct topline. Well angulated quarters with good width of thigh. He was presented in first class condition. Delighted to award him his third CC. Well deserved. 2 Taylor and Atyeo's Samelin Harris Tweed What a lovely type this boy is. He has a traditional head with defined stop and good length of foreface. Clean neck of good length leads to well laid shoulders which are becoming increasingly rare in the breed. Well ribbed with good length of body and firm in topline. He has a good turn of stifle with no exaggeration. Such a good honest dog. A pleasure to award him the RCC. 3 King's Dobbies Delight at Grantastar completed a trio of quality males.
Open (8,4)

1 Mitchell Withey and Cravos' Sorbus Belfry Lad At 5 is mature and well balanced through. Nothing out of place here. Well shaped head with correct amount of stop and well set ears. Strong in neck with well laid shoulders. Good width to his ribs and firm and short in the loin. He has good rear angulation with well turned stifles. A sound and honest type. Edged this class on his more positive hind movement. 2 Poynter and Lewis' Quensha Cowboys and Angels Only just two and for me has still a bit to do. His quality is there to see. Balanced in head with clean neck of good length. Well laid shoulders. He has good width to his ribs but lacked the depth of the winner. Firm in topline and well angulated quarters. He was presented in first class order. With maturity should go on to gain his title. 3 Kelly's Alolfrana Memphis Rock
Special Beginners (3,1)

1 Brown's Mariglen Top Gear at Yendorlech This light tri was in full coat in good overall condition. Masculine head with good reach of neck and decent shoulder angulation and nicely tucked in elbows. Good width to his ribs. He has good turn of stifle and hocks are nicely let down. 2 Salmon's Gillancette Day Dreamer Reserve in the graduate class. More settled here. Pleasing in head with kind expression. Well boned through. He has a firm topline and well angulated quarters. Still has some maturing to do. When he does, he should finish nicely.
David Howarth Judge
SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY CHAMPIONSHIP SHOW
17th NOVEMBER 2019
BITCHES
JUDGE MR NEIL KELLY

Thank you to the Officers and committee of the club for their kind invitation to judge at this friendly and well organised show. Also to my ring stewards for all their help and for keeping things running smoothly. To all the exhibitors thanks for bringing your dogs in such clean condition and for accepting my decisions so sportingly.
Minor puppy (1)

Patons Bournehouse Secret Destiny at Meadowfoot, pleasing puppy of just 7 months, very much a baby. Sweet head and dark eye. Well grown with good bone, lovely thick puppy coat. Moved steadily and happily enjoying her day out.
Puppy (2,1)

Pitts,Wandsfell Dream Maker, very smart puppy of quality, pleasing outline, pretty head and soft expression. Good length to neck with well placed shoulders, well bodied for age, level topline with correct tailset. Moved very well, I will watch her future with interest. Well deserved BPIS.
Veteran (6,2)

1.Mugfords Quensha Summer Nights at Lynwood, dark orange with beautiful head and dark expressive eye, excellent forechest and well sprung rib strong over loin, straight front and good width to quarters, shown in good coat and condition. Moved well.
2.Deerings Rosetimber Foxy Breeze, 9yrs blue, not showing her age,in glamourous coat and gleaming condition, moved with style and exhuberance. A credit to her owner.
3.Bryant and Hollis Phenset Ruby Tuesday
Junior (9,2)

1.Dennis,Morgan and Harris Gemsett Ice Cold in Alex at Mariglen, Quality orange with excellent shape and balance. Feminine head with dark eye, good length of neck into the best of shoulders giving correct forearm angulation, deep in chest with well sprung rib, level topline and strong well muscled quarters. Moved out well with drive.

2.Taylors Wansleydale Bizzie Bee, smart dark tri of just 12months, well constructed and showing lots of promise. Unlucky to meet 1 today, she has everything just right for her age and moved really well. One to watch!
3.Mugfords Alofrana Sugar and Spice at Lynwood
Yearling (2)

1.Raineys Ravensett Marbella at Wolmersdon, Pretty orange with good overall shape and balance, sweet head and gentle expression, would prefer more bone and substance. Moved well with lashing tail action.
2.Hoskins GillancetteLady of Leisure, Orange of different type, well made with good angulation fore and aft, difficult to assess as not handled to her advantage unfortunately. Moved OK.
Novice(3,1)
1.Taylors Wansleydale Bizzy Bee
2.Sharples Kanietter Saphira Well grown orange,appealing head, nice make and shape, a lot to like about her, just a little proud of her tail today. Moved well.
Graduate (6,1)

1.Hartle and Stones Hartsett Lady in Grey, this tri really caught my eye, most beautiful head with correct eye shape, long neck and excellent shoulder, deep in brisket, straight front, good rear angulation,short neat hocks, moved with drive and purpose. A very nice bitch.

2.Beasleys Wansleydale Amaretto, stylish tri with beautifully feminine head, slightly rounder in eye than 1,well placed front, clean over shoulders with strong level topline. Well presented and handled. Close up to 1. Moved well. Another very nice bitch.
3. Bryant and Hollis Phensett Sparks will fly.
Post Graduate(8,3)

1.Wales Wansleydale Magic Rose J.W, this orange bitch is teeming with quality, super outline, feminine head and dark almond shaped eye. Good front assembly with adequate layback of shoulder,level topline and strong loin. Rear quarters well angulated with strong short hocks. Moved with style and purpose, in excellent coat and condition, considered her for top honours. Her time will come !

2.Hartle and Stones Hartsett Cherry Blossom, another quality orange, with all the right credentials. Sweet head and soft expressive eye .Clean over neck and shoulders,Well angulated fore and aft,just lost out on movement today, but I think these two will change places many times. Beautifully presented as always from this exhibitor.
3. Henrys Beechanger velvet Crab.
Limit (9,2)

1.Grimsdells Tattersett Dark Honey JW Top quality orange, with lean well balanced head and dark eye, beautifully constructed throughout,with excellent forehand and deep brisket.She is short coupled and has well turned stifles,short hocks and neat feet. She has a strong level topline which she holds on the move. Just needs more coat to complete the picture. RCC

2.Loakes Goldbirch Wings of desire JW SHCM SHC EX, immaculately presented tri, not a hair out of place, I gave her best puppy last time I judged and I haven't changed my view. Presents a stunning outline, very pretty head, well constructed throughout, she just needs to develop more in forechest to finish the picture. Moved very well with lovely tail action.
3.Deerings Skylark of Rosetimber
Open (3)
Very strong class

1.Taylors ShCh Wansleydale Queen Bee JW, she was just what I was looking for! Most beautiful Blue, straight out of the top drawer. Well worked head with melting expression, good reach of neck flowing into well laid back shoulders. Short coupled, strong loin. So sound on the move both front and rear with correct lashing tail carriage. Overall she combines elegance with substance so typical of the breed. Absolutely loved her. CC and BIS.

2. Phillips,Bryant and Watkins ShCh Wansleydale Star Queen of Glenmaurangi, does not need me to introduce this top winning bitch. Litter sister to 1. Another top quality bitch with similar attributes, exquisite head and gentle expression, so well balanced throughout, super outline, moved very well, just not in her best coat today.
3.Grimsdells Tattersett Clever Cookie.
Special Beginners(3,1)
1.Beasleys Wansleydale Amaretto
2.Kerrs Ravensett Golden Charm, Dark orange with sweet head and dark eye, nicely made, presenting a pleasing outline. Well off for bone, neat feet,shown in good coat and condition. Moved OK.
Southern English Setter Society Championship Show - 17 November 2019 - Suntop Memorial Awards
I would like to thank SESS for their kind invite to judge these two classes.
This is always a nice friendly show which gets you into the Christmas spirit with their sherry and mince pies.
Suntop Memorial Award

Yearling (12,3) 1. Taylor's Wansleydale Bizzie Bee Just out of puppy this b/b & tan bitch certainly held her own in this class, very well made with feminine head and sweet expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, level top line with correct tail set and well bent stifle presented a balanced picture, very happy mover.

2. Taylor & Atyeo's Samelen Come Back Upstanding well balanced b/b dog masculine head, good length of neck and level top line,strong rounded bone, deep brisket and well angulated front and aft, moved freely.
3. Thacker's Hartsett Vanity Fair.

Open (14,4) 1. Schoneville & Derry's Hawklawn Khamsin At Balvenie JW This o/b dog caught my eye when he entered the ring and I was not disappointed classic head with plenty of work but not over done, dark eye giving such a soft expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, strong bone, deep brisket with elbows tucked well in, well bent stifle and short hocks, correct tail set which he used on the move. In good coat and condition, presented beautifully. Unbeknown to me this dog had 2 CC's and later in the day I saw him receive his 3rd - Congratulations.

2. Normansell's Latin Lover Rewind For Larrenie IMP ITA dark b/b dog clean outline, refined head with dark eye and lean neck, clean over shoulders, deep chest with elbows tucked in, good bone and body properties, well bent stifle moved freely.
3. Mellish's Wattlewood Silver Arrow To Monbrec.

pages.title: show critique 2021
blocks: Southern English Setter Society
33rd Breed Championship Show 21.11.2021

Sincere thanks to the Committee for the opportunity to award CC’s for the first time, to the exhibitors for entering under me and to my two superb, efficient stewards who kept everything running smoothly.
For me, it is still a concern to see so many dogs carrying their tails high, however, I was more than happy with my winners.
MPB 4

1. Seaman’s Mariglen Indigo 8 mths blue, in fabulous condition. Feminine throughout. Beautifully balanced outline. Loved her head and gentle expression, with correct eye shape and colour. Good lay of shoulder and strong topline. Neat feet. Steady on the move with lovely tail action, she covered the ground effortlessly. Should have a bright future ahead of her.

BPB & BPIS 2 . Loakes’ Goldbirch Hearts Desire Very pretty tri with dark eye, giving a soft expression. Well balanced with long neck leading into well angulated shoulders. Straight front and strong back end. Her tail never stopped wagging! Preferred the more positive front movement of 1
3. Grimsdell’s Tattersett Dark Amber

PB 6 (2): 1. Dennis’ Mariglen Unwrapped Light tri. Very balanced outline. Nice head with dark eye and low set ears. Well angulated front with good reach of neck. Level topline. Used her tail well on the move. 2. Sharples’ Kanietter Viennese Whirl Mature tri coloured puppy with dark eye. Balanced throughout. Short coupled with firm, level topline. Well muscled. Preferred tail carriage of 1. 3. Wale’s Cyanina Golden Rose
VB 2

1. Hartle’s Hartsett All My Lovin Pretty, feminine, elegant orange. Lovely head with dark eyes and kind expression, with well set ears. Balanced outline. Good reach of neck. Moved well, using her tail. Carrying a little too much weight today.2. Stephenson’s Lakecastle Kashmiri at Wistaston Light tri with lean head and dark eye. Good depth of chest. Short coupled with good back end. Not as positive on the move as 1.
JB 2
1. Dennis’ Mariglen Unwrapped 2. Hilditch’s Barleymoats Summer Breeze Well grown dark blue, with nice head and dark eye. Level topline. Lovely neat feet. Didn’t move her best today.
YB 3

1. Tompsett’s Leilasett Northern Lights Over Radbrooks Dark orange. Balanced outline. Pleasing head with low set ears and gentle expression. Nice width to front. Lovely back end with well bent stifles. In hard condition, positive movement, using her tail.2. Grimsdell & Stewart’s Tattersett Rainswept Pretty headed blue. Balanced outline. Needs more coat to complete the picture. Strong, positive movement. Preferred tail carriage of 1.3. Whiting & Grant’s Tattersett Frankel’s Storm at Ormstiga
NB 3
1. Dennis’ Mariglen Unwrapped 2. Grimsdell & Stewart’s Tattersett Rainswept 3. Hoskin’s Walshaw Watercolours

1. McCabe’s Rachdale Ribbons of Pearls Orange female. Lean head with dark eye giving a soft expression. Good bone and substance. Shoulders well angulated with good rear angulation. Tail well set on, which she used on the move. Out of coat today.

1. Tucker’s Walshaw Centre Stage Dark orange with flowing outline. Straight front. Well angulated shoulder. Good spring of rib and short coupled. Excellent topline. Nicely shaped, strong quarters with good bend of stifle. Well muscled. Didn’t put a foot wrong on the move. Strong, positive, driving action, using her tail well. RCC 2. Pitts’ Wandsfell Dream of Me Good head with dark eye and kind expression. Nicely balanced, short coupled with level topline. Tail well set on. Carrying a little too much weight today, which showed in her movement. Having said that, she is a very nice bitch, with lots to like. 3. Hartle’s Hartsett Lady In Grey

1. Grimsdell’s Tattersett Clever Cookie Lovely, elegant, flowing outline on this mature orange female. Good head proportions. Dark expressive eyes and good pigmentation. Excellent front with good depth of brisket. Moved with style, driving from her well angulated quarters, using her tail well. 2. Sharples’ Mariglen Serendipity at Kanietter Well balanced dark orange. Lovely head and expression with dark eye. Reachy neck leading into well angulated shoulders. Well turned, strong quarters. Moved well, but not as positive coming towards me as 1. 3. Buckley & Stubbington’s Tattersett Cool Roxy at Fishwick

1. Loakes’ Rachdale Painted Lace at Goldbirch Everything to like about this mature blue female. She completely filled my eye and was exactly what I was looking for. Exquisite head with dark eye and soft, melting expression. Perfectly balanced with clean, flowing outline. Clean through neck and shoulder and lovely front assembly. Well sprung ribs and good depth of brisket. Sweeping stifles. Well muscled, standing on neat feet. Moved positively with style and drive, with her head held high and lashing tail. Presented and handled to perfection. CC & RBIS 2. McCabe’s Sh.Ch. Rachdale Elegance JW Litter sister to 1. Elegant orange with good outline. Lovely head and expression with dark eye and good pigment. Excellent forehand with tight elbows. Well ribbed up. Moved well, using her tail. 3. Dennis, Morgan & Harris’ Gemsett Ice Cold In Alex at Mariglen
SB 2

1. Beasley’s Wansleydale Amaretto Very pretty tri female. Res in a strong PG class. Balanced throughout with good angulation. Moved well with good tail action. Stands on neat feet. 2. Whiting & Grant’s Tattersett Frankel’s Storm At Ormstiga Orange female with lean head, nice expression with low set ears. Pleasing outline. Short coupled. Not as positive in front movement as 1.

Thankyou to the officers and committee for inviting me to judge the Memorial Stakes classes at this show. Thankyou to the exhibitors for their entries and presenting a quality group of setters, I enjoyed the experience very much.
SUNTOP MEMORIAL AWARD (Yearling Dog or Bitch) (12,4)

1st:- 77 Wood's Juldeane Prime Suspect. A mature 23-month-old Orange Belton dog, shown in lovely condition. A masculine head with dark eye, good reach of neck, flowing into well angulated shoulders. Moved well, balanced and with drive.

2nd:- 66 Tuckers Mariglen Night Wish for Walshaw. An attractive 11-month-old Blue Belton dog. Mature looking for age with a gorgeous well proportioned head, dark eye and appealing expression. Moved happily with lashing tail just not quite as balanced as first.
3rd:- Wale's Cyanina Golden Rose
SUNTOP MEMORIAL AWARD (Open Dog or Bitch) (15,5)

1st:- 21 Harris's Bridgella's First Edition with Konakakela. A striking Orange Belton dog with a super head and masculine expression. Lovely well proportioned body shape, good spring of rib and good angulation throughout. In great coat and condition, good firm muscle overall with firm second thigh, moved very well with plenty of drive and correct tail carriage. A picture on the move which clinched first place.

2nd:- 51 Schoneville and Derry's Balvenie Blue Sensation. A Blue Belton dog who pushed number 1 from the outset. At only 2 years old is surprisingly mature. A well proportioned head with good reach of neck, well angulated shoulders and good turn of stifle, shown in lovely condition. Moved happily with just a little less drive than first.
3rd:- 55 Sharples Mariglen Serendipity at Kanietter
Anne Harding (Cumbersett)

pages.title: show critique 2022
blocks: SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY CHAMPIONSHIP SHOW
DOGS

Thank you to the Society for inviting me to judge and their perseverance to hold the show when they had to delay after the hall fire. Many thanks to the exhibitors who braved the January weather and entered their dogs. I must mention the lighting which is still needing attention and did not allow me to make a judgement on eye colour. Hence my omitting any description regarding eye colour in my report.
The entry was not numerically large but I was pleased with my line up. Thank you all including my lovely stewards Kassia and Anne for giving me an enjoyable day.
Veteran Dog (2,1)
1st King's Dobbies Delight at Grantastar.

When standing this boy of 8 years gave the correct overall picture of an English Setter. Such a pleasing head balanced from foreface to occiput. Oval eye with ears set low, folding against head. Elegant but strong neck into correct lay of shoulder. Has correct length to upper arm. Excellent depth and strong over loin. Sweeping length hip to hock with good width of second thigh. Tail set on as required which was used on the move. Tight feet. Unfortunately, today just dropped his shoulder on the move.
Junior Dog (1)
1st King's Sirius Blue Heaven at Grantastar

Young tri boy still at the growing stage, who tends to stand tall. His skull is nicely broken and this gives a very pleasing eye shape. Correctly placed ears falling close to skull. Would have preferred less depth of foreface but has a correct bite. Correct depth of fore chest and strong back with short coupling. Tail set on correct, moved OK.
Yearling Dog (4,1)
1st Stewart and Quenby's Tattersett Golden Sunrise.

A compact dog with a balanced outline. Standing on good feet and round bone. Head balanced but a little plain, correct scissor bite. Ears set low to skull. Pleasing forearm and lay of shoulder leading to a strong back. Fine depth and spring of forerib. Short coupled with rounded quarters and well bent stifles. A sound and happy mover.
2nd Williams' Richecca Midwinter.

I loved this dog's head plains and expression. Straight front and has an elegant length of neck leading to adequate shoulder placement. Tight feet with straight pasterns and required length of upper arm. Not as short coupled as 1st. Fine sweep from hip to hock. Moved soundly.
3rd Ward's Mariglen Wilbur
Graduate Dog (4)
1st Tucker's Mariglen Night Wish for Walshaw

This young dog has super bone and was shown in excellent hard condition. Straight front with depth to fore chest and stands on tight feet. Has the break in skull to give the oval eye. Clean in throat and natural high head carriage. Balanced forearm and hind angulation. Firm level back and strong on croup with correct tail placement. A steady and precise mover.
2nd Ciaputa's Wansleydale Skyfall
A blue dog with a beautiful balanced skull, his raised eyebrows and work gives the oval eye and soft expression. Ears set low and close to skull. Elegant neck set into
correctly angulated shoulders. Fine depth but not as short coupled as class winner. Good length hip to hock. Correct width of stifle. Moved off on tight feet. In good coat.
3rd Whittington's Juldeane Line of Duty
Post Graduate Dog. (4)
1st Wood and Weller's Juldeane Prime Suspect. (A.I.)

Quality orange, not a big dog but so very well balanced. He has a straight front with depth to fore chest. His head equal front to occiput and has the required brake in skull to provide a correct eye shape and expression. Open nostrils and not overdone in depth of flew. A correct bite with good sized teeth. Ears set on low and laying close to skull. Arch to neck allowing correct head carriage. Balanced, length of upper arm and shoulder placement allows his forelegs to sit close to his deep sprung chest but extend on the move. He is short coupled and has good width between his pin bones giving rounded quarters and strong hind angulation. Not in his best bib and tucker but I forgave him this when he moved with fore arm reach and drove through his hocks, his tail flowing off his back. RCC.
2. Sykes' Bumblecorn Robin at Daraquist
Dark Blue with a beautiful classic head and eye. He has elegance and is well angulated throughout with a fine set on of his tail. Shows promise but he has a lot of maturing to do. Shown in good coat.
3.Whittington's Juldeane Line of Duty
Limit Dog (6)
1st Schoneville and Derry's Balvenie Blue Sensation

Balanced skull from muzzle to occiput, not overdone in depth of flews. Has the required soft expression of our breed. Ears low set and correct length of flap laying close to skull. Straight front with round bone, straight pasterns and standing on good feet. Sprung rib cage with length and depth. A good width between pins and tail falling gradually off his back. Has width of stifle and correct let down to hock. Moved with animation using tail action and keeping a firm top line.
2. Lyons' Swannery Laxton Fortune to Mierlees.

This dog's coat was in fine condition and length but felt it distracted from showing the outline. I was delighted when going over him to find everything was of good quality. A lovely head, good neck and shoulders. Deep ribs, balanced fore and hind angulation which allows him to move freely. His tail is well placed. If the owner can collect him more on the move and address the abundance of coat, I personally would hope he can trouble the best.
3, Lawson's Wansleydale Dorian Grey JW
Open Dog (5,3)
1st Taylor's and Atyeo's Samelen Comeback Special

This beautiful dark blue belton filled my eye with quality. He has nothing overdone. A superb balanced head with beautiful eye shape. Correct bite, wide nostrils but not too much flew. Ears set low and close to skull. He is clean in throat. Carries his head high using his elegant neck which melts into his oblique shoulder placement. Plenty of depth to chest and spring of rib. Now fully mature his hind rib is fully sprung. Short coupled and strength over loin. His hind quarters are long above the hock and short below. Has good width of stifle.

I have never seen him move so well, he drove off parallel hind quarters and showed reach, drive, and a strong level topline. His naturally high head carriage completed my picture of an elegant, first rate English Setter.
DCC and in agreement with my co judge BIS.
2nd Darley's Sh Ch Severnsett Firecracker

It is not difficult to see why this dog has his title. A beautiful balanced head and the kindest of expressions. Clean throat, strong neck. He has good bone and super depth to his frame. Has great rounded quarter and required length from hip to hock. These attributes with his width of stifle allows him to power off his hind quarters when on the move. Presented in beautiful coat.
3rd Wilson's Ravenset Giovanni
Special Beginners (4)
1st Ward's Mariglen Wilbur

This young dog has a correct shaped head, balanced neck and is clean over his shoulder. He is straight in front with round bone and feet. His fore and aft angulation are even. A lovely happy boy, he has a good coat but I would like more substance and for his handler to move him slower and more collected.
2nd Ciaputa's Wansleydale Skyfall (as before)
3rd Salmon's Gillancette Day Dreamer.
Val Isherwood (Dog judge)

pages.title: champ show critique 2022 bitches
blocks: Southern English Setter Society, 15th January 2023 Bitches

I thank the SESS Officers and Committee for their hospitality and for a very enjoyable day. You can always be assured of a warm and friendly atmosphere at the Southern English shows. Thanks to my very able stewards, Dilys and Rita, for keeping everything in order. I was happy with my final lineup, although many of the bitches were not in their best coats today.
Minor Puppy Bitch (4,2)

1st: Sharples’ Kanietter Sabonette: 7month-old b/b very good balance and size for age. Outgoing and not overawed by the occasion. Gentle, pleasing expression, oval eyes with low set ears. Good reach of neck flowing into correctly placed shoulders. Well developed in body including depth and spring to ribs. Kept topline on the move with tail set just dropping off back, just needs to settle when moving which will come later. Should give owner some fun going forward. BP & BPIS:

2nd: Bevan’s Mariglen Bronte (TAF): Just six months old, so not as well developed in body as 1. Very pretty, feminine head with kind eyes. Has decent shape and proportion to body. Level in topline and moved with verve from good rear quarters.
Veteran Bitch: (1)

1st: Taylors and Atyeo’s Samelen Golden Taffeta: Lovely 8-year-old o/b, dam of BIS winner. Good clean definition and shape to skull, with dark eyes and kind expression. Body has good spring to rib together with depth, a moderate length back, looks well-proportioned giving balanced outline. Good angulation to hindquarters which have strength together with good muscle tone. Enjoyed her day out and moved soundly to win BVIS.
Junior: (2,1)

1st: Dearings Pettifox Of Rosetimber: 15month o/b, to begin with was unsettled when standing, but did improve. Very pleasing head, good stop with soft, kindly eyes. Has decent shape and balance in her body which now needs to fill. Ribs are well rounded with medium length to back, rear quarters have well bent stifles. Hocks straight and let down when viewed from rear.
Yearling: (4,1)

1st: Jennings-Sharman and Sharman’s Wansleydale Mayfly: Liked this 20 month tri, exceptionally well developed and balanced for her age. Clean cut and relatively lean oval head, well defined stop with tight, kind oval eyes. Good front, straight from forearm down, elbows well tucked close, tight feet, lean and arched neck with well-set shoulders. Ribs have adequate spring, depth and are well carried back. Muscular hindquarters with good bend to stifle and straight in hock. Moved steadily, keeping her outline and balance, which helped her to win this class today.

2nd: Beasley’s Wansleydale Mayflower: So little to choose between these two, litter sisters, as I found later, so many comments from above apply. Growing on well and has plenty of promise in balance, shape, and size. Head has sufficient brain room with definition to occiput, defined stop with pleasing expressive bright eyes.

3rd: Collis & Passey’s Richecca Winter Melody: 23½ month light tri but not quite as together in body as 1 and 2. Friendly and outgoing, feminine with well-proportioned head, ears set in line with bright gentle eyes. Symmetrical angles to fore and rear quarters. Happy mover, carrying herself well.
Novice: (2,1)
1st: Collis & Passey’s Richecca Winter Melody.
Graduate: (2)
1st: Jennings-Sharman and Sharman’s Wansleydale Mayfly: As before.

2nd: Dennis, Morgan and Harris’ Mariglen Unwrapped JW: Beautiful head, very feminine light tri, soft, kind, and expressive oval eyes, low set ears, carried close to cheek. Long and lean in neck with clean throat. Good angulation to fore and rear quarters but without exaggeration. Body has depth, moderate length in back and tail set well in line.
Post Graduate: (4,1)

1st: Tucker’s Walshaw Center Stage: O/b with lovely shape and working of head, completely balanced. Good front, the shoulder blades had just the right width at withers with good layback. Long thighs from hip to hock with width, muscle tone and strength. Overall has a very balanced shape, with level topline and was one of the best movers today, showing plenty of free driving movement from hindquarters.

2nd: Tompsett’s Leilasett Northern Lights Over Radbrooks: Well-made O/b with just the right substance and shape. Has feminine head, good dark, soft expressive eyes. Neck flows into shoulders cleanly and with right amount of layback. Body proportions balanced both in length, spring in rib and depth.
3rd: Reiths Niddbeck Smokey Islay At Ownways.
Limit: (6,2)

1st: Tucker’s Walshaw Save The Last Dance: Good class and could change places, just preferred positive movement today from my winner. B/b with a very typical, feminine head with plenty of work coming from stop, chiseling, and expressive bright eyes. Front was very true, with short pasterns, well up on toes. Correctly placed shoulders, moderate length to back with short coupling. Good depth and spring to ribs, balanced in proportion throughout. Strong hindquarters including muscle to thighs. Moved well from rear with drive.

2nd: Mugfords Alolfrana Sugar N Spice At Lynwood: Another tri who I really liked. Has balance and substance without coarseness. Lovely head of oval shape, good stop and reasonable depth to muzzle, gentle, expressive dark eyes. Long neck, flowing into good placement of shoulder. Showing a balance over body and hind quarters. Just fell short on her movement today.
3rd: Mariglen Serendipity At Kanietter.
Res: Darley’s Severnsett Dark Angel.
Open: (3)

1st: Dennis, Morgan and Harris’ Sh Ch Gemsett Ice Cold In Alex At Mariglen JW: Awarded her best puppy over 3 years ago. she has grown into a very elegant, quality, orange bitch. Beautiful clean head, with defined stop with dark, expressive eyes, ears set close and low to her cheeks. The arched neck flows cleanly into the withers with well-angulated shoulders, medium length body with depth, short coupled, with good sweep to the hindquarters and correct tail set. Thus, giving a very symmetrical outline. A little more coat today would have truly completed the picture. BCC, RBIS and BOS

2nd: Rumble’s Jotunheim Ooh La La: Close, but just preferred the balance of 1. Orange, good front construction, straight with depth and adequate width to brisket, well up on tight feet. Liked her head, carried well, with balance between skull shape and muzzle. Expressive, kind eyes, and low set ears. Mature and well ribbed, good angulation over front and rear quarters. Moved well in challenge with head held high to win RCC.
3rd: Hoskins Gilancette Lady of Leisure.
Judge: Christopher Bird

blocks: JUDGES REPORT - S.E.S.S. OPEN SHOW 16/06/06
Southern English Setter Society Open Show at Worplesdon, Nr Guildford, Surrey on Sunday 16th July 2006.

It was a pleasure to judge the Southern English Setter Open Show held at Worplesdon. The weather really was too hot to show dogs, which reflected in the number of absentees, so I fully understand why exhibitors wanted to keep their dogs at home. Nevertheless, I want to thank all exhibitors and dogs that did come along and the Officers and Committee who rounded off what was for me a most enjoyable day especially by providing some shade in the ring for myself and the dogs. BIS Day's Decoverly Celtic Venture, RBIS Gilbert's Mariglen Steals the Show at Shadowood BPIS Dunks' Samelen One Man, BVIS Young's Ownways Touch of Spice.
Minor Puppy Dog (4, 2a)

1. Taylor and Atyeo's Samelen Saturn and 2. Thompson's Samelen Jupiter. Two raw 6 mth old litter brothers, both well made with gentle expressions and dark eye, just preferred the steadier movement of 1. Both need lots of time to grow into their legs.

Puppy Dog (3, 1) 1. Dunk's Samelen One Man. Handsome 10 mth old orange pup showing a great deal of promise, super head, gentle expression with dark eye. Good reach of neck into well placed shoulders. Well bodied. Moved very steady for one so young. BPIS. 2. Wood's Bournehouse Lord Harry. 10 mth old blue, bit of a handful, lovely head with dark eye, straight front in good coat, would have preferred better bend of stifle. Moved ok.

Special Veteran Dog (7 - 9 years) (5, 3) 1. Williams' Richecca Could It Be Heaven. 7yr old blue with attractive head, well angulated shoulders and lovely bend of stifle. Really covered the ground. In good coat and condition. 2. Jolley's Belleset Masterpiece of Jolymore. Close up to 1. Nice headed 7yr old orange, good angulation front and rear, moved well.

Special Veteran Dog (10 years & Over) (2)1. Sayers' Cumbersett Raven Rebel of Christter 10yr old blue, good head with dark eye giving soft expression. Long neck, well bent stifle and level top line, really drove round the ring. BVD. 2. Jolley's Upperwood First Knight of Jolymore. 11yr old tri, masculine head with gentle expression, straight front, barrel ribs, with good tailset. Moved ok.

Junior Dog (3, 1) 1. Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire. Really liked this balanced blue youngster, lovely head and neck with gorgeous expression, well angulated front and rear, super bone with clean outline, in good coat, moved soundly and so happy. Will watch his future with a great deal of interest. RBD 2. Cozens' Earldoms Bold Forester. Not a very happy boy today, handsome b/b/t, lean head with gentle expression, soundly put together. Just needs more confidence.
Yearling Dog (0)
Maiden Dog (1)1. Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire.
Novice Dog (2, 1)1. Cozens' Earldoms Bold Forester.

Graduate Dog (6, 4)1. Kay's Steelcross Blue Tango. Blue with masculine head. Has balanced angulation fore and aft. In good coat and feather. Moved well. 2. Hammond Hartsett Paper Skye for Oaktrish. Lighter built orange, nice head, dark eye, lovely spring of rib in good coat. Steady mover.

Post Graduate Dog (9, 3) 1. Lyons' Wandsfell it Wasn't Me at Mirrilees. Not a glamour boy, but sound tri with most appealing head and melting expression. Scored in neck and front assembly. Short coupled with level topline. Good coat and feather. Moved well with wagging tail.2. Young's Ownways Money Talks. Very sound blue, with attractive head and nice expression. Well made throughout. Great spring of rib. Level topline. Good coat. Moved steady. Well presented as always from this kennel. 3. Holland's Mandyset Dirty Dancing.

Limit Dog (7, 1) 1. Day's Decoverly Celtic Adventure. What an attractive dark tri he is, lovely to go over. Beautiful head with the softest of expressions, balanced angulation all through, presenting an appealing outline, with enough coat to complete the picture. Moved well and so sound for BD, and moved even better in the challenge to gain BIS. 2. Montgomery's Carbine Istabraq of Radlake. Sound honest blue, another lovely headed boy with soft melting expression, great front and rear angulation with sweeping stifle. Moved soundly. 3. Reith's Kenmillen Crusader

Open Dog (8, 5) 1. Mariglen Romantic Scene at Brookedge. Had written in my notes what a handful and naughty boy! Nevertheless a tri with appealing head, dark eye and soft expression, well placed shoulders, powerful rear end which he really used to drive round the ring. Loads of coat and feather and obviously enjoys his food.. 2. Hammond's Bournehouse Paper Parade for Oaktrish. Tri with lovely head and dark eye giving gentle expression, Well made throughout. Level topline with good tailset. Moved steady. 3. Ellis Albadora Blue Trooper with Hocuspokus

Special Beginners Dog (4) 1. Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire 2. Reith's Kenmillen Crusader. Nicely made tri with lean head, dark eye and kind expression, well angulated fore and aft with level topline, moved ok.3. Jolley's Dyrham Don't Stop Me Now in Jolymore

Minor Puppy Bitch (3, 1) 1. Ellis Hocuspokus Pumpkin Pie well made 9 mth old tri, pretty head and expression, long neck, well bodied and in good coat, moved steady and happy. Just needs time. 2. Ellis Hocuspokus Love Potion o/b, litter sister to 1 with the same attributes, just preferred hind movement of Pumpkin Pie.
Puppy Bitch (4, 2) 1. Ellis Hocuspokus Pumpkin Pie 2. Ellis Hocuspokus Love Potion

Special Veteran Bitch (7 - 9 years) (1,1) Special Veteran Bitch (10 years & Over) (2, 1) 1. Young's Ownways Touch of Spice. Lovely orange lady with appealing head, dark eye and soft expression, good overall construction with level topline and so sound. 11 yrs of age and you wouldn't guess by the way she moved round the ring, she certainly showed a few youngsters how to move! BVIS.

Junior Bitch (6, 1) 1. Young's Touch N' Try. Quality sound tri, gorgeous head and expression, well of for bone. Great angulation fore and aft. good spring of rib with lovely short tail. Presenting a super outline. Moved well. Has plenty of time to mature and will be watching her progress. 2. Swannell's Bournehouse Secret Love at Rickory. Another quality girl, mature orange with lovely head and soft expression, good reach of neck into well placed shoulders, well bent of stifle and tail set. In lovely coat and feather. Moved soundly but just felt the heat affected her. 3. Reith's Ownways Touch N Tell

Yearling Bitch (3, 1) 1. Croft's Ravensett Dark 'N' Delicious with Thistlesett. Feminine blue, lovely head, dark eye giving a gentle expression. Reachy neck into well angulated shoulders. Short coupled with great spring of rib. Strong quarters with super bend of stifle. Level topline and good coat. Moved happily. 2. Salmon Richecca Fancy Colours. Attractive headed tri with good front angulation and body properties. Well presented. Would prefer better bend of stifle.
Maiden Bitch (0)

Novice Bitch (4) 1. Reith's Ownways Touch N Tell. Very feminine blue with pretty head and expression. Long neck and balanced construction. Moved steady. Needs lots of time to mature.2. Tompsett's Radbrooks Wild Honey. Attractive mature orange, with feminine head and kind expression, straight front. well bodied with good bend of stifle. Moved ok. 3. Garbutt's Pewterspeare Pot of Gold

Graduate Bitch (4, 2) 1. Day's Mandyset Ready Steady Go to Decoverly. Two quality bitches, A real sweetie, compact orange with pretty head and gentle expression. Well angulated front and hindquarters. Good spring of rib. Moved well. 2. Harradine's Halliana Dancing Queen. Close up to 1. Blue with lovely chiselled head, dark eye and soft expression. Good angulation front and rear. In full coat. Moved steady but felt didn't cope with heat as well as 1.

Post Graduate Bitch (4, 1) 1. Young's Ownways Touch The Money. Elegant sound blue girl with pretty head and expression, nice reach of neck, correct angulation both front and rear, in good coat. Moved steady. 2. Aldridge's Salisbury Plain Babe at Fleckers. Judged her last as a pup and has matured into an attractive headed orange with kind expression. Straight front. Good rear angulation and level topline. Overall a nice shape. Moved ok. 3 . Christian's Funforce Lunar Eclipse

Limit Bitch. (9, 5) 1. Gilbert's Mariglen Steals the Show at Shadowood. Blue of lovely type, very feminine from the tip of her nose to the tip of her wagging tail. Very pretty head with gentle expression, great reach of neck. Well laid back shoulders, and strong well angulated hindquarters which she used to advantage on the move. Such a happy mover to win BB but just flagged a little in the heat against the dog. RBIS. 2. Hewitt's Tattersett Demure. Nicely balanced blue. Appealing head and expression, lovely reachy neck. Soundly put together with level topline. Moved well. Just preferred hind movement of 1. 3. Osborne's Wistaston School Out of Time At Quailmoor

Open Bitch (5, 3) 1. Cozens' Earldoms Destiny Child. Have judged this quality bitch before, dark tri with the best of heads and softest expression. Balanced angulation throughout, great spring of rib. Moved steady and so sound. Just lacked the sparkle of Steals the Show. RBB.2. Tompsett's Radbrooks Wouldn't It Be Nice. Tri with pretty head and expression, nicely angulated front and rear. Pleasing in outline and in good coat. Carried herself well on the move.

Special Beginners Bitch (2)1. Osborne's Wistaston School Out of Time At Quailmoor. Orange girl with feminine head and gentle expression, straight front, well bodied, moved ok.2. Salmon Richecca Fancy Colours
Brace (3, 1) 1. Jolley's. A well matched pair of orange boys with good heads who moved in harmony round the ring.
Anne Lewis Judge
SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY
OPEN SHOW - SUNDAY 16 JULY 2006
My thanks to all exhibitors and dogs for turning out on this exceptionally hot day, as by these midday classes, many were really feeling the heat. I had two lovely classes and enjoyed my appointment.
MICHAEL WINCH SPECIAL YEARLING MEMORIAL CLASS - 7 (3abs)

1) Croft's Ravensett Dark 'N' Delicious with Thistlesett - Dark Blue Bitch, 20 months old. Sweet head, with soft expression. Good reach of neck, shoulders well laid back and good forearm angulation. Short coupled with well bent stifle, tight feet. Excellent coat and condition. After an erratic start, moved well, with slashing tail and keeping level topline. 2) Dunks' Samelen One Man - Promising orange dog 10 months old. Stunning head, already showing work, dark eyes. Correct shoulders. Short coupled with deep body, super round bone and neat feet. Steady and happy mover. 3) Taylor & Atyeo's Samelen Saturn.
LESLEY ALLAN-SCOTT OPEN MEMORIAL CLASS - 18 (8 abs)

1) Holland's Mandyset Dirty Dancing - Elegant Blue boy that has matured nicely. Masculine head, with dark eye, low earset and good length of neck into well placed shoulders. Tight feet, good depth of body, superb sweep of stifle with plenty of muscle. In full coat and excellent presentation. Moved with enthusiasm here, which won him the class. 2) Day's Decoverley Celtic Venure - Well constructed Blue Belton and Tan, nice head with well defined stop and dark eye, straight front, excellent spring of rib and plenty of bone, good bend of stifle. Moved O.K. but seemed to be feeling the heat by this time. Good coat and condition. 3) Young's Money Talks .
Cheryl Collins (Judge)

pages.title: judges critique
blocks: JUDGES REPORT - S.E.S.S. OPEN SHOW 15/06/07
SOUTHERN ENGLISH SETTER SOCIETY
Sunday 15th July 2007
Judge: Mrs Jakki Stubbington (Bondgate)

My thanks to the exhibitors for a quality entry of beautiful dogs and bitches, all of which had consistently good heads, which I believe to be the essence of this breed. Some exhibits did, however, lack in depth of chest and movement varied widely. Sadly, some very well constructed entries left their best coats at home on the day.

I must also thank my stoic stewards, Doreen and Clive and the officers and committee for their kind hospitality and hard work in producing the show. The weather was a bit iffy in the afternoon and not everyone agreed with the decision to move inside for the bitch judging. Thankfully, it cleared up enough for us to move outside for the challenge for BIS etc. BIS Dennis's Mariglen Pengtsson's Legacy. RBIS and BOS Littlechild's Sh Ch Ravensett Bianca. BPIS Collier's Ravensett My Kinda Guy at Roszarke BVIS Dunks' Sh Ch Samelen Shooting Star
MINOR PUPPY DOG (3,2)

1 Collier's Ravensett My Kinda Guy at Roszarke. Striking, well grown o/b 8mths. Very pleasing head and neck which gave him the edge in the challenge for best puppy dog. Well off for bone. Moved v well for a youngster, keeping his outline and topline and so sound, fore and aft. BPD and BPIS. 2 Young's Decoverly Sundance to Brookedge. Close up to 1 but preferred head and bone of 1. BPIS These 2 will probably change places many times.
PUPPY (I)

1 Sykes' Daraquist Down Under Stood alone but a worthy winner. Lovely o/b. Really liked him. Kept his outline on move with good tail action. Beautiful forehand with good bone and nice short pasterns. Good bend of stifle and well let down hocks.
SPECIAL VETERAN DOG 7 - 9 (3)

I would just like to comment that the veteran classes were an absolute joy to judge with some fabulous oldies and all a real credit to their owners to present them in such good order. It filled my heart to see the way these oldies performed, enjoying every minute of it and I felt honoured to see some of my old favourites on the day. Thank you! 1 Barker and Godfrey's Sh Ch Caleydene Endeavour for Elmwood. Very striking still at nearly 9 years of age. Excels in construction with the longest of necks. In good coat. Lively mover, really enjoying his day out 2 Mellish's Ownways Moving Shadow for Monbrec. 8 yrs Another fine example of the breed. Very close decision, just lost out to 1 on movement. 3 Jolley's Bellesett Masterpiece of Jolymore. Withdrawn as a little lame.
SPECIAL VETERAN DOG 10 AND OVER (2, 1)

1. Dunks' Sh Ch Samelen Shooting Star Truly remarkable 10 y/o presented in top condition. A real credit to his owner. Beautiful head and expression. Excellent conformation, still very sound on the move. Would give some of the younger dogs a run for their money. Best Veteran dog and BVIS.
JUNIOR DOG (5, 3)

1.Wright's Fishwick Dancing Lad V pleasing 15 m/o o/b. Good head and expression with nice dark eye. Soundly constructed, presenting good outline. Good forehand, depth of chest, turn of stifle and nice feet. Plenty of bone. Nice coat and good tail action. Very sympathetically handled. 2 Jolley's Wansleydale Loganberry at Jolymore. Another nice youngster, close up but just preferred movement and forehand of 1. 3 Arkley's Hartsett Poetry in Motion.
YEARLING DOG (6,5)

1. Dennis's Mariglen Pengtsson's Legacy BD & BIS Love this elegant young b/b from head to tail. Glorious lean balanced head with dark eye and kind expression. Superb neck into clean shoulders and level topline which he holds very well on move. He is so balanced, well muscled and sound throughout and a very flashy light blue. Beautifully presented. He oozes ring presence which gave him the edge over the bitch in the challenge for BIS. I am sure he will go on to be one of the top winning dogs in the breed with time. 2.Tucker's Walshaw Moonstorm Half brother to 1 and similar type but shorter in neck and longer coupled. 3.Dunk's Samelen One Man.
MAIDEN DOG (2,0)
NOVICE DOG (4,3) 1.Wright's F Dancing Lad 2,. Wood's Bournehouse Lord Harry 3. Arkley's H Poetry in Motion
GRADUATE (5, 4)

1. Mellish's Harvancourt in Touch with Montbrec. 3 y/o b/b. Good lean head with melting expression. Very good forehand and depth of chest. Good bend of stifle, v good bone, nice feet. 2. Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire. Flashy b/b, longer cast than 1, thought he was my class winner standing but let himself down on the move. 3. Holland's Earldoms Whispering Forest.
POST GRADUATE (5,3)

Super class 1.Malins Taurkel Gold Quest. Elegant 3y/o o/b with lovely outline. Pleasing head with long reach of neck into well placed shoulders. Correct tailset Good bone and nice short hocks. V well presented in super coat. Pushed hard for BD. RBD. 2. Young's Ownways Money Talks. Another lovely dog but just preferred overall outline of 1. 3. Tuckers Walshaw Party With Me.
LIMIT (3,2)
1.Holland's Mandysett Dirty Dancing b/b 5 y/o Smaller type but all in proportion. V good bone, good forehand and bend of stifle. 2. Hall's Tattersett Capercaille.
OPEN (6, 2)

1. Halstead's Hammoon Fly By Night. 7 y/o b/b and an old favourite of mine. So v soundly constructed which reflects in his true movement. He kept his topline on the move and really used his tail. Excels in forehand and bend of stifle. Unfortunately, left his best coat at home on the day. 2. Tompsett's Radbrooks Break Away.
SPECIAL BEGINNERS DOG (7,7)

1. Slack's R Dark Fire Handsome blue dog with a lot to like. Moved v erratically in earlier class but steadier in this one. Pleasing head and expression, presented in good coat. Good bone, feet and tail action. 2. Wood's B Lord Harry 3. Arkely's H Poetry in Motion
MINOR PUPPY BITCH (5,4)

1. Richard's Decoverly Sweet Caroline with Rubuscott. Gorgeous o/b one I would like to take home with me. Correct in all departments. V pretty head and darkest of eyes. Should go far. BPB. 2. Day's Decoverly Mamma Mia. Close up to 1 but 1 has, in my opinion, the edge on forehand and head. 3. Davis Culverwell Calypso
PUPPY BITCH (2, 2)
1. Hewitt's Tattersett Double Action. Fine tri bitch with kind expression, moved well. Just needs to body up. 2. Pitts Norglens Heaven Help Me at Wandsfell. S
PECIAL VETERAN BITCH 7-9 years (5, 3)

1. Halstead's Sh Ch Hammoon Little Nutmeg BVB 2. Sykes' Calypso Belle at Daraquist Two lovely old ladies and a very hard decision to split but preferred head and expression of 1. Both a credit to their owners for presenting them in such good order. Both have super conformation. 3.Rieth's Elusive Shadow.
SPECIAL VETERAN BITCH 10 years and over (7, 3)

1. Young's Ownways Touch of Spice. Cracking 13 year old o/b who is an old favourite of mine. This class was fabulous and all were a real credit to their owners. The movement of the winner would put that of younger dogs to shame - she held her topline so well on the move! 2. U'ren's Bensophie Dame Delmelza 3. U'ren's Bensophie Miss Mellion
JUNIOR BITCH (1.1)

1. Oliver's Wansleydale Cloudberry at Bramstorm. Stood alone but well deserving of 1st place. This beautiful tri bitch has a v good forehand, good depth of chest and bend of stifle. Lovely head and sound, happy mover. Well presented and sympathetically handled.
YEARLING (1,1)
1. Montell's Culverwell Summer Colours. Nice tri bitch presented in good coat. Super head, darkest of eyes, good bend of stifle, moved well.
MAIDEN AND NOVICE (2,1) Rpt Junior
GRADUATE (6,3)

1. Young's Ownways Touch n Try. Super tri bitch with v good angulation fore and aft. Pretty head, good depth of chest, nicely presented in good coat. Moved soundly.2. Tompsett's Radbrooks Wild Honey.3. Reith's Ownways Touch n Tell
POST GRADUATE (7,2)

1. Cockett's Hollygrove Secret Love. Very striking b/b bitch. Dark eye with gorgeous expression. Superb length of neck reaching into good forehand. Lovely outline with correct tailset. 2. Wyatt's Culverwell Rhapsody in Blue Bitch with similar qualities to 1 but not the same forehand. Both moved well.
LIMIT (9,5)

1. Hewitt's Tattersett Demure b/b with most appealing dark eye. Good topline and strong over loin, nice bend of stifle with well let down hocks.2. Tompsett's Richecca Party Colours for Radbrooks. 3. Aldridge's Salisbury Plain Babe at Fleckers
A really nice class full of quality bitches. I was splitting hairs to arrive at my final placings. My decisions revolved around weight, balance and resultant toplines.

1. Littlechild's Sh Ch Ravensett Bianca. Glorious o/b bitch, very well presented in super condition. Typical feminine expression. Good angulation fore and aft. V strong over loin. Moved soundly. BB and RBIS. 2. Oliver's Wansleydale Songbird at Bramstorm. Another gorgeous bitch, tri with v dark eye, well presented. I was splitting hairs over these two. RBB. 3. Morgan's Fishwick Queen of the Night at Quensha.
SPECIAL BEGINNERS BITCH (6, 5)
1. Davis's Merleycopse Love of a Lady. b/b with nice lean head and long neck. Good forehand, nice bone and feet. In good coat 2. Wyatt's C R in Blue
Jakki Stubbington

pages.title: judges critique 2008
blocks: JUDGES REPORT - S.E.S.S. OPEN SHOW 13/06/08
SINGLE BREED SHOW
Sunday 13th July 2008
The Southern English Setter Society held an Open Show which was a quality entry of fine-looking exhibits all in beautiful coat and condition, a credit to their owners.
BIS: Mariglen Francesca Fenston RBIS: Tattersett Final Edition
BP: Walshaw Christmas Rose for Ownways BV: Sh.Ch Samelen Shooting Star
MINOR PUPPY DOG 3(1)

1st Mellish's Walshaw Christmas Spirit at Moonbrec 6 month o/b, lovely youngster, well put together, attractive head, well-angulated, good bone, sound happy mover. Litter brother to BPIS. 2nd Wood's Swannery Magical Moment b/b nice youngster, well made, good bone, attractive head. Moved correctly once settled.
PUPPY DOG 1

1st Morgan's Quensha Pinball Wizard mature o/b, attractive head with soft expression, good neck, well constructed body, deep chest, good muscle tone. Excellent positive movement for such a youngster. BPD
SPECIAL VETERAN DOG (7 to 9 years) 2 (1)

1st Mellish's Ownways Moving Shadow for Moonbrec well constructed b/b, beautiful head, dark eye, good neck and shoulders, good quarters, in lovely condition and coat, a strong well balanced dog with a powerful driving action.
SPECIAL VETERAN DOG (10 Years and over) 2(1)

1st Dunk's Sh.Ch.Samelen Shooting Star b/b a worthy Sh.Ch and in his 11th year still looks a picture. Well angulated, lovely head with dark eyes giving that true melting expression. In wonderful condition, well muscled up such a sound positive driving action a credit to his owners. BVIS
JUNIOR DOG 2

1st Montell's Culverwell Flashman a very mature youngster b/b/t attractive head, dark eyes with lovely soft expression, good neck, good hind angulation, good bone, in lovely coat, moved soundly with drive. 2nd Cooper's Settrenda Cuts the Mustard b/b/t 14 months old lost out to the more more mature junior dog. Well made, nice outline, good bone, lovely head, beautiful soft expression. Moved soundly.
YEARLING DOG 4(1)

1st Young's Decoverly Sundance to Brookedge sturdily built o/b, presenting nice outline, attractive head, good length of neck, good quarters, good front, good depth of chest. A well balanced youngster who moved soundly.2nd Shadwell's Swannery Dark Secret nice looking b/b, good outline, attractive head, good length of neck, good angulation, good bone and well coated, sound mover. 3rd Brown's Tatterset Double Barrel
MAIDEN DOG 2
1st Cooper's Settrenda Cuts the Mustard. 2nd Morgan's Quensha Pinball Wizard
NOVICE DOG 7 (1)

1st Critchell-Imms' Bartholeys Bogart attractive b/b nicely constructed, good head and expression, good length of neck, deep chest, good quarters, in lovely coat. Sound mover. 2nd Shadwell's Swannery Dark Secret. 3rd Brown's Tatterset Double Barrel
GRADUATE DOG 6(1)

1st Dunk's Samelen One Man upstanding o/b, lovely outline, masculine head, dark eye giving that melting expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, good front, deep chest, good hind angulation, well muscled which showed in his sound positive movement, good tail action. 2nd Wright's Fishwick Dancing Lad fine-looking o/b, good outline, good angulation, lovely head and eye with melting expression, reachy neck, excellent lay of shoulder, close up to 1 not the positive movement, needs firmer handling. 3rd Young's Decoverly Sundance to Brookedge
POST GRADUATE DOG 7(2)

1st Grimsdell's Tatterset Final Edition a quality elegant b/b/t, stunning eye-catching outline, beautiful classic head, good soft eye, lovely expression, strong muscular neck into well laid shoulders. Well-angulated strong quarters. A well balanced dog in great coat and hard condition, looked a picture. Excellent mover with sound positive driving action using his tail to advantage.RBIS/BOS. 2nd Young's Decoverly Sundance to Brookedge. 3rd Slack's Ravenset Dark Fire
LIMIT DOG 5(1)

1st Malin & Oliver's Taurkel Gold Quest o/b with a lovely elegant outline lovely head on a good long muscular neck into well laid shoulders, good deep chest, in beautiful coat and condition. Moved with sound driving action. 2nd Holland's Mandyset Dirty Dancing b/b with a good clean outline, nice head on a good reachy neck. Strong hindquarters giving powerful movement. 3rd Montgomery's Carbin Istrabraq of Radlake
OPEN DOG 2

1st Tomsett's Radbrooks Break Away Lovely outline, well bodied b/b/t lovely head, dark eye, soft expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, excellent strong hindquarters, well balanced moved with drive. RBD 2nd Young's Ownways Money Talks light b/b, lovely clean outline, attractive head good reach of neck, well angulated, strong quarters. Well balanced moved with drive.
SPECIAL BEGINNERS DOG 5(2)
1st Shadwell's Swannery Dark Secret 2nd Holland's Ownways Legal Tender o/b of good type, nice outline, pleasing head, good expression, good length of neck. Sound mover.3rd Atyeo's Samelen Saturn
JUNIOR PUPPY BITCH 1

1st Young's Walshaw Christmas Rose for Ownways loved this 6 month old o/b so feminine, pretty head with the softest of expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, well angulated. A mature youngster who moved with such exuberance, so enthusiastic her tail never stopped wagging.BPIS
PUPPY BITCH 3(1)

1st Stanton's Sorbus Three Wishes a well-constructed o/b, pretty head, lovely soft expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, deep chest, mature body, good angulation, good sound free mover with drive. 2nd Morgan, Bott & Petheric's Quensha Little Jeanie femine o/b, lovely head, dark eye kind soft expression, good length of neck, well constructed, good angulation, sound free mover.
SPECIAL VETERAN BITCH (7 to 9 years) 3(1)

1st Young's Ownways Touch of Glory JW a lovely petite o/b bitch, pretty feminine head, beautiful soft expression, well constructed with good angulation. In lovely condition, a sound positive mover with drive and good tail action enjoying herself. 2nd Dunk's Samelen Star Shine JW b/b pretty feminine head with lovely dark eye giving that soft expression, well put together and in excellent hard condition, good bend of stifle, good driving action, super mover with good tail action.
SPECIAL VETERAN BITCH (10 years and over)(1.1)
JUNIOR BITCH 3

1st Dennis & Field's Mariglen Francesca Fenston an eye catching quality o/b, a real showgirl brimming with ring presence. So feminine, beautiful outline, compact body, stunning head, melting expression, super reach of neck into lovely shoulders, first-rate quarters. Strong quarters which gave her effortless drive and sound positive movement, yet so graceful. In gorgeous coat and condition, mature for one so young. I understand she gained a well deserved JW on this win. BIS. 2ndCooper's Settrenda Golden Promise feminine o/b, attractive head, good eye, good length of neck, nice outline, well constructed, good bone, good turn of stifle, moved well. 3rd Mumford's Kierembell Orange Blossom
YEARLING BITCH 5

1st Grimsdel's Tattersett Double Florin quality feminine b/b, lovely clean outline, well angulated. Classic feminine head, good eye lovely soft expression good reach of neck into well laid shoulders. Well muscled up moved with effortless drive, excellent tail action. 2nd Day's Decoverly Mamma Mia full-bodied o/b, well constructed, feminine head, kindly expression, reachy neck into well laid shoulders, good turn of stifle. Moved well. 3rd Richard's Decoverly Sweet Caroline with Rubuscott
MAIDEN BITCH 2 & NOVICE BITCH 2

1st Morgan,Bott & Petheric's Quensha Little Jeanie, 2ndMumford's Kierembell Orange Blossom o/b well constructed, pretty head, good eye, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, good front and good sweep of stifle. Moved well.
GRADUATE BITCH 5(1)

1st Grimsdell's Tatterset Double Florin.2n Oliver's Wansleydale Cloudberry at Bramstorm attractive and well constructed b/b/t pretty head, good front, good depth of chest, good bend of stifle. Positive sound happy mover with good tail action. 3rd Davis's Culverwell Calypso of Merleycopse
POST GRADUATE BITCH 4(3)

1st Tomsett's Radbrooks Wild Honey well constructed o/b, pretty head, soft expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, good depth of chest, good hindquarters in good hard condition, lovely sound happy mover, good tail action.
LIMIT BITCH 5

1st Grimsdell's Tattersett Air of Elegance beautiful o/b, clean elegant outline,classic attractive feminine head, dark eye, soft expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, good deep chest and super hindquarters giving her a lovely sound driving movement, a happy mover with good tail action. 2nd Tomsett's Richecca Party Colours for Radbrooks pretty o/b lovely clean outline attractive feminine head, soft expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders, good angulation. Sound happy mover with a good tail action.3rd Bartholomew's Tattersett Mystic Dream at Bartholeys
OPEN BITCH 5(1)

1st Oliver's Wansleydale Songbird at Bramstorm pretty b/b/t beautiful outline, attractive feminine head, dark eye with soft expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, good forequarters, good bend of stifle. Lovely balanced bitch moving with drive and style using her tail well. RBB 2nd Dunk's Samelen Star Bright stylish b/b, classic feminine head, lovely dark eyes giving that melting expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, good front, good strong hindquarters. Well balanced bitch who moved with great style and a good tail action. 3rd Hewitt's Tattersett Demure
SPECIAL BEGINNERS BITCH 4(3)
1st Davis's Culverwell Calypso of Merleycopse o/b nice outline, feminine head dark eye with soft expression, good length of neck into good shoulders, deep chest, good bend of stifle. Sound mover.
BRACE 1
1st Morgan &Bott's & Petherick's brace nicely matched pair moved out well together.
Marje Burt: 16 Beechwood Avenue St Albans Herts AL1 4YA :01727 832609 burt.abbeysett@ntlworld.com
Southern English Setter Society Open show Stakes Classes
One general comment, I was concerned by the prevalence of constructional faults in both front and back ends. Please watch these when breeding. On the plus side all dogs were clean and well presented.
Michael Winch Yearling Memorial Award (8, 1ab)
Two nice bitches headed this class

1st Cozen's Larrenie Bony Lass at Earldoms. 19 months O/B, Good length of neck, textbook shoulders. Deep well sprung ribs, short coupled and well set on tail, in good coat. Moved soundly with correct tail action.

2nd Morgan, Bott & Petherick's Quensha Little Jeanie, feminine, promising O/B. Preferred her head and bone, but not the shoulders of 1. lovely body and topline. Giving a lot away in maturity but her sound movement gave her place here. Well handled.
3rd Richard's Decoverly Sweet Caroline with Rubuscott
Lesley Allan-Scott Open Memorial Award (6,2ab)

1st Day's Mandyset Ready Steady Go To Deoverly. Won here with a bit to spare. Mature O/B, wish there was more of her to enjoy, but she is so well balanced. Presents a lovely shape when stood. Soft expression, good length of neck, beautiful shoulders, and straight front, deep body, short coupled, good width across the thigh. Moves sound and true.
2nd Slack's Ravensett Dark Fire, upstanding Dark Blue, beautiful head with the darkest of eyes giving a soft expression, good body, and sound backend. Just not the forehand or overall balance of 1.
3rd Montgomery's Carbine Istabraq of Radlake
