21.07.2019 Southern English Setter Society Open Show - Memorial Awards

Thank you to the Society for inviting me to judge at the SESS Open Show 2019. I was made very welcome and had a lovely day. Thank you also to those who entered the Memorial Classes. Presentation was exceptional and it was a privilege to judge your dogs.
Michael Winch Special Yearling Memorial Award (7,2)

1. Sharples' Kanietter Seraphina. Well-constructed 8 month orange bitch with lean head, low ears, dark eyes and the softest expression. Clean neck into well laid shoulders with good return of upper arm. Deep chest, decent ribs, short coupling and level topline. Excellent bend of stifle to balance her front and a well set tail. Didn't give away her age on the move, covering the distance with drive and style.

2. Worthy's Tattersett Big Orange. 21 month orange dog in excellent coat and condition. Balanced head, good eyes and a kind expression. Decent neck flowing into good shoulders and a strong topline. Deep in chest, tight elbows and nicely bodied. Strong on the move, with lovely width to the rear. Not quite the angles of 1, but a very promising boy.
3. Taylor & Ateyo's Samelen Comeback Special. Gentle blue boy who just needs time to develop.
Lesley Allan-Scott Open Memorial Award (6,2)

1. Thompsett's Radbrooks Sloop John B. Handsome tri dog of correct proportions. Chiselled head with low ears and expressive dark eyes. Long neck into nicely laid shoulders with good return of upper arm. Short coupling, standing well at the rear with excellent bend of stifle. Elegant on the move, elbows tucked in, lovely forward reach and using his tail well. Would like a little more body and coat to complete the picture.

2. Taylor & Ateyo's Samelen Golden Taffeta. Well-presented orange bitch, in good coat and condition. Strong head with dark eyes, a clean, elegant neck and level topline. Nicely balanced angles to her front and rear construction. Excellent spring of rib and good bone throughout. Not quite as true as 1 on the move today.
3. Stirk's Mariglen Perfect Day For Grakar ShCM. Lovely blue girl, so enthusiastic she gave her handler a hard time in this class.
Eleanor Bryant

pages.title: open show critique 2021
blocks: Southern English setter society open show 2021

Firstly I would like to thank the committee for inviting me to judge the memorial classes at this well run open show. It was a lovely day in the sunshine and felt like a garden party. My thanks also go to the exhibitors who entered and gave me the opportunity to go over their dogs.
Michael Winch Yearling dog or bitch (3, 1a)
1st Mr N, Miss E M C Bryant & Mrs V Hollis’ PHENSET FINAL FANTASY

A pretty blue belton bitch, possesses a nice head with kind expressive eyes and low set ears. Long, lean neck leading to muscular shoulders and a level topline. Ribs well sprung for her age. Moved well considering the heat in the sunshine today.
2nd Mrs H J Wilkinson’s PHENSET FIRESTORM

Smart Orange dog who I see is a litter sibling to first. Similar marks apply here. This boy has a beautiful head, plenty of stop, dark expressive eyes and low set ears. Good topline and well set tail. Not quite as settled on the move as his sister today.
Lesley Allan-Scott Open Memorial Dog or Bitch (9, 5a)
1st Mrs S D Loakes’ RACHDALE PAINTED LACE AT GOLDBIRCH

This blue belton bitch commanded my attention from the moment she entered the ring. Coped very well with the heat. Very pretty head, love her blue patch around her eye. Bright and expressive dark eyes, enough stop and raised brow which gives her the most exquisite expression. Long and lean neck, leading to well placed shoulders and a level topline. Well sprung ribs, deep chest and strong through the loin. Well angulated. This girl didn’t disappoint on the move either, moved freely with grace and elegance but still showing power and drive from her hindquarters. Carried her head high. There’s no denying this girl’s quality, definitely one to watch with interest.
2nd Ms J Ateyo & Mr A Taylor’s SAMELEN COMEBACK SPECIAL

There’s no hiding the fact that I love this boy. Very much my type. Beautiful dark blue belton dog presented in plenty of coat and good condition. Beautiful head properties, muscular neck and shoulders leading to a level topline, and well set tail, deep in chest, widely sprung ribs and deep in back ribs. Plenty of bone without being too heavy to retain his elegance. Well angulated which gave a nice silhouette stacked.
Unfortunately he just didn’t seem to cope well with the heat today, but nevertheless I couldn’t deny his quality in head and body properties..
Judge - Olivia Danks-Kemish

pages.title: open show critique 2022
blocks: Southern English Setter Society
Special Memorial awards
It was an honour and a pleasure to judge the two Special Memorial award classes at the Southern English Setter Society Open Show
Yearling 3/1abs

1st Tucker's MARIGLEN NIGHT WISH FOR WALSHAW A stylish upstanding 20mth old blue dog giving a lovely balanced profile. Good masculine head with dark eye and intelligent expression. Deep through body, strong bone, good feet and well muscled with true powerful accurate movement.

2nd Dennis' MARIGLEN UNWRAPPED JW Blue proportionally smaller bitch. Now I know they are litter mates and they give an ideal illustration of the difference between a dog and a bitch. All the same comment apply, just not quite so well muscled as the dog and therefore not such drive on the move as the dog.
Open 10/5

1st Derry's BALVENIE BLUE SENSATION A beautiful powerfully built mature dog, classic head with a noble, benevolent expression. Lengthy strong neck, good shoulders and good bone and feet. Well muscled quarters, another powerful mover.
2nd Reith's NIDDBECK SMOKEY ISLAY at OWNSWAY An eye catching, quality tri-colour bitch, all angels and construction correct. Just lost out to the maturity and style of the dog.
3rd Bishops' DYRHAM DE JA VUE A close decision between 2nd & 3rd. Blue bitch of equal quality not the precision and positive movement of 2nd.
The winning dog was also Best in Show. Well done! Sure he deserves top honours.
Graham Lambert:- judge

pages.title: judges critique
blocks: JUDGES REPORT - S.E.S.S. OPEN SHOW 18/07/04

Thanks to the officers and committee for making me feel welcome and of course the exhibitors for preparing and showing on the day. The weather was perfect and I very much enjoyed the opportunity to judge your dogs. BIS was Cockett's Hollygrove Liarbility RBIS Halstead's Hammoon Little Nutmeg BOS Barker's Elmwood Glentana BPIS Cocketts Hollygrove Penny Puzzle. BVIS Wright's Wynacre Summer Gold.
DOGS
Puppy (1)

1st Well's Hollygrove Storyteller of Ritanor. Well grown 9 month old blue, very much a baby. Nice shaped head soft expression lovely dark eye. Good reach of neck into good shoulders, correct length of body. Obviously at this age muscles are still developing therefore still very much at the gangly stage, overall nice puppy BPD
Special Veteran Dog 7-9 years (3:2a)
1st Brayshaw's Carganey Gambling Man very young looking eight year old in excellent condition thoroughly enjoyed his run around the ring.
Special Veteran Dog 10+ (1)
1st Wright's Wynacre Summer Gold How good this ten year old orange boy still looks very stylish well muscled for his age and it showed going around the ring. BVIS
Junior (2)

1st Kirsch's Shining Star of Sorbus 13 month old blue, nice shaped head kind expression overall correct body shape. I remember him looking so mature as a puppy, looked less mature today but plenty of potential. 2nd Day's Decoverly CelticVenture
Sp. Yearling (5:2a)

1st Day's Decoverly Sandpiper superb orange boy, loved his head good length of neck into well laid shoulders level topline, correct tailset and good rear angulation moved well. 2nd Young's Mariglen Romantic Scene at Brookedge 3rd Hammond's Hartsett Paper Skye for Oaktrish
Maiden Dog (2)
1st Well's Hollygrove Storyteller of Ritanor 2nd Kirsch's Soulmate of Sorbus
Novice (5:1a) 1st Kirsch's Shining Star of Sorbus 2nd Day's Decoverly Celtic Venture 3rd Young's Mariglen Romantic Scene at Brookedge
Graduate (10:2a)
1st Day's Decoverly Sandpiper 2nd Holland's Mandyset Dirty Dancing 3rd Young's Ownways Money Talks
Post Graduate (9:2)

1st Barker & Godfrey's Elmwood Glentana dark blue, gorgeous head dark eyes with that typical melting expression, long neck into well placed shoulders, good length of upper arm excellent depth of brisket, short coupled. Nice clean outline. BD & BOS 2nd Hammond's Bournehouse Paper Parade for Oaktrish 3rd Brays haw's Carganey Manhattan
Limit (3:1a)

1st Hammond's Bournehouse Paper Parade for Oaktrish very masculine light tri, classic head good reach of neck, nice lay of shoulder, very well bodied excellent bend of stifle in good coat, he moved as if he had the weight of the world on his shoulders hence his 2nd place in Post Graduate.2nd Hayden's Mariglen Gershwin of Hayworth
Open (3:3a)
Sp Beginners(2:1a)
1st Hollands Mandyset Dirty Dancing nice looking blue dog everything ok just a tendency when standing to slope his topline thus giving him an unbalanced outline.
BITCHES
Minor Puppy Bitch (3:1a)

1st Swannell's Richecca Romance with Rickory. These sisters looked like they had just hatched 1 was much more mature than her sister, sweetest head, superb reach of neck good length of body excellent rear angulation, she moved like a playful baby which of course she is.2nd Swannell's Richecca Role Model at Rickory
Puppy Bitch (4:2a)

1st Cockett's Hollygrove Penny Puzzle. Very classy blue bitch, 9 months old. Gorgeous head, nice dark eye sweetest expression, good reach of neck into well laid shoulders. Good depth of body excellent coat, moved very well BPB & BPIS 2nd Cockett's Hollygrove Secret Love
Special Veteran Bitch 7-9 yrs (3:1a)
1st Barker & Godfrey's Sh Ch Elmwood Felicity 9 year old dark blue looking very good, well presented. Both these girls went round the ring with style. BVB 2nd Young's Ownways Touch of Spice
Special Veteran Bitch 10+ yrs
1st Dunk's Samelen Star Performer 10 years plus dark blue bitch in fantastic condition, enjoyed her trip around the ring more, I think, than her handler.
Junior Bitch (5:2a)

1st Bryant's Phenset Phoenix Rising very stylish 16 month orange very feminine, have admired her from ringside so it was lovely to be able to go over her. I was not disappointed just right for her age extremely pretty head, well constructed overall good mover. I am sure she will do well in the future. 2nd Tod & Christians Funforce Luner Eclipse 3rd Malby's Phenset Third Lady
Sp. Yearling Bitch (1)
1st Bryant,s Phenset Phoenix Rising
Maiden Bitch (3:1a)
1st Malby's Phenset Third Lady nice blue bitch good overall shape in very good coat.2nd Hatley's Wynacre Amber Queen at Fairfleck
Novice Bitch (3:1a)
1st Haltead's Hammoon Hidden Treasure very attractive orange looked lovely standing, just a little erratic in movement seemed reluctant to use her tail. 2nd Young and Bevan's Penny Royale
Graduate Bitch (11:3a)

1st Halstead's Hammoon Firefly very similar to her half sister in previous class. Very stylish, classic head, long neck into well laid shoulders level topline good rear angulation. Again she did not want to use her tail but her quality shone through to take this class. 2nd Hewitt's Tattersett Demure 3rd Pearce's Westonfields Pick A Lily
Post Graduate (4:2a)

1st Cozens Earldoms Destiny's Child dark tri in good coat a little on the plump side. Feminine head very sweet expression, good front assembly level topline. Good sweep of stifle moved well.2nd Reith's Elusive Secret Shadow
Limit (4:2a)

1st Dunk's Samelen Star Bright dark blue very smart looking bitch nice head into long neck, fairly balanced outline although a touch loose in front . However flowed around the ring really driving from behind.2nd Pearce's Westonfields Honeysuckle
Open (5:2a)

1st Cockett's Hollygrove Liarbility classic English Setter dark blue almost six years old and in my opinion just coming to her best. Superb overall outline everything in the right place. When you look into her eyes she just asks to be first and when she moved around the ring she was and BIS 2nd Halstead's Hammoon Little Nutmeg I have to say I like this stylish orange very much and thought she would be my winner, but she just did not move as well as 1 in the class. I had no hesitation in giving her RBIS.3rd Bryant's Taurkel Special Delight at Phenset
Special Beginner Bitch (5)

1st Hewitt's Tattersett Demure pretty blue bitch nice head, expression slightly spoilt by her light eyes. Good overall construction moved out well.2nd Malby's Phenset Third Lady 3rd Young & Bevan's Ownways Penny Royale
Stella Oliver ( Judge )
Michael Winch special yearling memorial class

1 Bryant's Phenset Phoenix Rising. Pretty young lady with pleasing head, good reach of neck and correct angulation especially at rear. Sound on the move. Well presented and handled. 2 Hammond's Hartsett Paper Skye for Oaktrish. Good size boy with well rounded bone. Not as finished as the bitch which is what one would expect at this age.
Lesley Allan-Scott special open memorial class.

1 Halstead's Hammoon Little Nutmeg. Standing presented a balanced picture with that "look at me" air about her which made her stand out in a good mixed class. Nearly threw it away on the move but when settled got it together and deserved her first place. 2 Land's Tattersett Firebird. Not the ring presence of my winner but nicely made all through and didn't let me down on the move. 3 Barker & Godfrey's Elmwood Glentana
Jennifer Gilbert (Judge)

pages.title: judges critique
blocks: JUDGES REPORT - S.E.S.S. OPEN SHOW 17/07/05
Southern English Setter Society Open Show at Chieveley Village Hall on 17/07/05

I found the dogs were all clean and well presented, the weather was very hot which unfortunately influenced movement in many cases, the bitches coped far better than the dogs. I thoroughly enjoyed my day, although I wished I had more red cards as decisions were very close in a number of classes.
BIS Westonfields Orangina RBIS Ownways Moving Shadow at Monbrec
BP Wansleydale Magic Star BV Ownways Touch of Spice

PD (4,1) 1) Wale's Wansleydale Magic Star Well balanced orange, lovely head and expression, nice neck and shoulders, short coupled with a good spring of rib, plenty of bone,moved freely, one to watch. 2) Beckwith's Swannery Zeus, different type to 1, well balanced tri, nice head and expression, good angulation fore and aft ,moved well. 3) Carlin's Wynacre Lord of the Dance for Sodalitas.

SVD 7-9 yrs (4,2) 1) Beckwith's IR/Dutch/Lux Sh Ch Tattersett Time is Time, 7yrs old short coupled well coated orange, nice head, correct eye shape, good neck & shoulders, level topline held on the move, moved well in the heat BVD 2) Cooper's Earldoms Master of Menace, 9 yrs old, masculine head and expression, well laid shoulder moved with enthusiasm.

SVD10 yrs & over (3,1) 1) Pearce's Westonfield Wooster at nearly 11 yrs old was enjoying his day out, short coupled tri, pleasing head and dark eye, moved with slashing tail.2) Offer's Ownways Pacific Blue,10 yrs old, longer cast than 1, nice head and expression, well ribbed up, correct tailset, in goodcoat, struggled in the heat on the move.

JD (3) 1) Malin's Turkel Gold Quest mature orange , nice outline, good head and neck, deep chest, level topline with correct tailset moved soundly. 2) Tucker's Walshaw Party With Me, well balanced head, straight front, good shoulders and rear angulation,happy mover. 3) Beckwith's Swannery Zeus.

YD (2,1) 1) Well's Hollygrove Story Teller at Ritnor dark blue, stood alone but a worthy winner, lovely head and kind expression, well angulated, good spring of rib, neat feet, moved with drive using his tail.
MD (2) 1) Wale's Wansleydale Magic Star, 2) Tucker's Walshaw Party With Me.
ND(3) 1) Wale's Wansleydale Magic Star 2) Tucker's Walshaw Party With Me 3) Beckwith's Swannery Zeus.

GD (2,1) 1) Kirsch's Soul Mate of Sorbus, short coupled blue, elegant head, well laid shoulders, straight front, nice turn of stifle, furnishings completed the picture moved well. 2) Dunk's Samelen City Gold, close up to 1, masculine head and soft expression, good reach of neck, correct construction, well muscled moved with drive just needs coat to complete the picture.

PGD (7,1) 1) Kirsch's Shining Star of Sorbus, litter brother to the winner of the last class, mature blue in good coat, masculine head but not overdone, gentle expression, well angulated front and rear, plenty of bone, move with drive.2) Day's Decoverly Celtic Venture, short coupled dark tri, pleasing head and dark eye, straight front and nice lay of shoulder nice turn of stifle, moved soundly.3) Young's Ownway's Money Talks.

LD (5) 1) Day's Decoverly Sandpiper nicely balanced orange, excellent head and dark eye, lovely length of neck, straight front, well bodied, tight feet, moved true using his hocks. RBD 2) Brayshaw's Carganey Manhatten, well constructed blue, in good condition, nice head and expression, good spring of rib, moved with drive.3) Cooper's Tremorgan Prince of Wales to Settrenda

OD (7,2) 1) Mellish's Ownways Moving Shadow at Monbrec. one I have always liked, mature blue, lovely head and melting expression, good length of neck into well laid shoulders, correct tailset and nice turn of stifle, moved well. BD 2) Tompsett's Radbrooks Break Away, elegant head and kind expression, good angulation, well bodied, moved soundly. 3) Beckwith's Gib/Dutch/Lux Sh Ch Mariglen Force the Pace with Becksett.
SBD (2,1) 1) Holland's Mandyset Dirty Dancing mature well bodied blue in good coat, pleasing head, strong neck, deep chest, tight feet, moved ok.

PB (5)1) Attwood's Swannery Blue Velvet nicely balanced blue, femine head and expression,good reach of neck, well constructed, in good coat, moved well. 2) Croft's Ravensett Dark "N" Delicious, compact blue baby, clean outline, pretty head, nice shoulders, good sweep of stifle, moved ok, would prefer slightly more of her 3) Pearce's Westonfield in the Stars.

SVB 7-9 years (2) 1) Barker & Godfrey's SH Ch Elmwood Felicity at almost 10 years of age this dark blue is in lovely condition, sweet head and expression, good overall confirmation, moved with style. 2) Aldridge's Brenholm out of the Blue at Fleckers, 9 year old well coated blue enjoying her day out, feminine head and expression, good angulation, moved with animation.

SVB 10 years & over (1) 1) Young's Ownways Touch of Spice approaching eleven and still looking good, pretty head and soft expression, good shoulders, level topline and correct tailset, moved so well for her age , well presented BVB
JB (2,1) 1) Haigh & Hollis's Taurkel Royal Delight Compact blue, lovely outline, feminine head, nice reach of neck, well bodied for age, moved really well with slashing tail.

YB (4,1) 1) Aldridge's Salisbury Plain Babe at Fleckers, orange sweet head and dark eye, lovely reach of neck, good spring of rib, nice turn of stifle, moved well with drive 2) Cockett's Hollygrove Secret Love, feminine head and expression, short coupled, nice turn of stifle, moved well. 3) Wyatt's Culverwell Rhapsody in Blue.
NB (2) 1) Haigh & Hollis's Taurkel Royal Delight. 2) Bevan & Young's Ownways Penny Royale

GB (5,2)1) Cockett's Hollygrove Penny Puzzle pretty headed blue, nice reach of neck into well laid shoulders, good body, level topline, correct tailset, stylish mover. 2) Young's Ownways Touch the Money.Close up to 1, mature blue in good coat feminine head and expression, well sprung ribs, good turn of stifle, move with drive.3) Salmon's Fenston Danse Du Feu

PGB (7,2) 1) Pearce's Westonfields Honeysuckle short coupled orange, lovely head and expression, nice dark eye, well angulated front and rear, in good condition, moved with enthusiasm. 2) Wilkinson & Ludbrook's Mariglen Prefect Diamond by Beckantie, well coated blue, sweet head, good spring of rib, nice turn of stifle, needs to loose a little weight, moved true. 3) Atwood's Swannery Blushin Valentina

LB (3) 1) Oliver's Wansleydale Songbird at Bramstorm, pretty tri, pleasing outline, exquisite head and gentle expression, correct construction, good spring of rib, happy mover, well presented. RBB. 2) Bryant's Taurkel Special Delight at Phenset, different type to 1, feminine head with correct eye shape, nice neck and shoulders, good turn of stifle, moved well. 3) Reith's Elusive Secret Shadow.

OB (7,4) 1) Pearce's Westonfields Orangina, well balanced orange, beautiful head and melting expression, lovely reach of neck, nice layback of shoulder, good angulation front and rear, level topline, the furnishings completed the picture, moved with drive using her hocks. Pulled out that bit extra today and I was please to award her BB & BIS. 2) Oliver's Bramstorm Blue Print JW, well coated short coupled blue, feminine head and soft expression, ,good angulation and spring of rib, nice turn of stifle, moved well. 3) Cooper's Tremorgan Golden Bracken to Settrenda

SBB (6,1) 1) Montell's Culverwell Carenza mature orange, pretty head and dark eye, nice neck and shoulders, level topline, tail well set on, good turn of stifle, moved true.2) Bevan & Young's Penny Royale, unlucky to meet 1, nicely made blue, sweet expression, lovely dark eye, neat feet, moved with purpose. 3) Reith's Elusive Secret Shadow
Jane Bishop (Judge)
Stakes and Handling classes - Judge V E Lyons
Thank you for your entries which made for a very enjoyable appointment for me.

Michael Winch Sp. Yr. Memorial Stakes (6, 1 absent) 1 Aldridge's Salisbury Plain Babe at Fleckers O/B bitch 21 months beautiful head and expression well arched neck into well placed shoulders, short coupled, well angulated rear quarters, moved happily and with drive using the correct tail action. 2 Well's Hollygrove Story Teller at Ritanor B/B dog Mature head good long neck leading into well placed shoulders, good deep body, well angulated front and rear short coupled neat feet did not move as freely as 1 on the day but could easily change places on another day,. 3 Malin's Taurkel Gold Quest.

Lesley Allen-Scott Sp Open Memorial Stakes (10, 5 absent) 1 Oliver's Wansleydale Songbird at Bramstorm Tri Bitch Feminine head, super expression good neck leading into good front short coupled great sweep of stifle neat feet in good coat and hard condition, a joy to watch on the move at one with her handler. 2 Young's Mariglen Romantic Scene at Brookedge Very mature tri dog masculine head, nice expression, good front well bodied good angulation on the hindquarters, correct tail action, gave his owner a hard time. 3 Cozens Earldoms Destinys Child
